items.name: bQ_andb
items.statement: Lemma bQ_andb : forall a b, bQ (andb a b) == (bQ a * bQ b)%Q.

items.name: bQ_negb
items.statement: Lemma bQ_negb : forall b, bQ (negb b) == (1 - bQ b)%Q.

items.name: bQ_orb
items.statement:
Lemma bQ_orb : forall a b, 
  bQ (orb a b) == (bQ a + bQ b - bQ a * bQ b)%Q.

items.name: bool_dist_le
items.statement:
Definition bool_dist_le {n} (F : MV n) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  exists g : Corner n -> bool,
    l1_norm (mv_sub F (embed g)) <= d.

items.name: bool_dist_embed
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_embed : forall n (g : Corner n -> bool),
  bool_dist_le (embed g) 0.

items.name: l1_norm_ext
items.statement:
Lemma l1_norm_ext : forall n (F G : MV n),
  (forall m, F m == G m) -> l1_norm F == l1_norm G.

items.name: bool_dist_le_mono
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_le_mono : forall n (F : MV n) (d d' : Q),
  bool_dist_le F d -> d <= d' -> bool_dist_le F d'.

items.name: bool_dist_add_absorb
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_add_absorb : forall n (F G : MV n) (dF : Q),
  bool_dist_le F dF ->
  bool_dist_le (mv_add F G) (dF + l1_norm G).

items.name: bool_dist_add_absorb_r
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_add_absorb_r : forall n (F G : MV n) (dG : Q),
  bool_dist_le G dG ->
  bool_dist_le (mv_add F G) (l1_norm F + dG).

items.name: bool_dist_wrt
items.statement:
Definition bool_dist_wrt {n} (F : MV n) (g : Corner n -> bool) : Q :=
  l1_norm (mv_sub F (embed g)).

items.name: bool_dist_le_iff
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_le_iff : forall n (F : MV n) (d : Q),
  bool_dist_le F d <-> exists g, bool_dist_wrt F g <= d.

items.name: bool_dist_wrt_self
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_wrt_self : forall n (g : Corner n -> bool),
  bool_dist_wrt (embed g) g == 0.

items.name: mv_sub_add_split
items.statement:
Lemma mv_sub_add_split : forall n (F G : MV n) (gF gG : Corner n -> bool) (m : Mask n),
  mv_sub (mv_add F G) (mv_add (embed gF) (embed gG)) m
  == mv_add (mv_sub F (embed gF)) (mv_sub G (embed gG)) m.

items.name: bool_dist_wrt_add
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_wrt_add : forall n (F G : MV n) (gF gG : Corner n -> bool),
  l1_norm (mv_sub (mv_add F G) (mv_add (embed gF) (embed gG)))
  <= bool_dist_wrt F gF + bool_dist_wrt G gG.

items.name: mv_gp_ext_r
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_ext_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G1 G2 : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    (forall m, G1 m == G2 m) ->
    mv_gp sq F G1 U == mv_gp sq F G2 U.

items.name: mv_gp_ext_l
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_ext_l :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F1 F2 G : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    (forall m, F1 m == F2 m) ->
    mv_gp sq F1 G U == mv_gp sq F2 G U.

items.name: Qeq_minus_l
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_minus_l : forall a b c : Q, a + b == c -> a == c - b.

items.name: mv_gp_sub_r
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_sub_r : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (m : Mask n),
  mv_gp sq F (mv_sub G H) m == (mv_gp sq F G m - mv_gp sq F H m)%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_sub_l
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_sub_l : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (m : Mask n),
  mv_gp sq (mv_sub F G) H m == (mv_gp sq F H m - mv_gp sq G H m)%Q.

items.name: gp_error_split
items.statement:
Lemma gp_error_split : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G eF eG : MV n) (m : Mask n),
  mv_sub (mv_gp sq F G) (mv_gp sq eF eG) m
  == mv_add (mv_gp sq F (mv_sub G eG)) (mv_gp sq (mv_sub F eF) eG) m.

items.name: bool_dist_wrt_gp
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_wrt_gp : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n)
  (gF gG : Corner n -> bool),
  (forall i, Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1) ->
  l1_norm (mv_sub (mv_gp sq F G) (mv_gp sq (embed gF) (embed gG)))
  <= l1_norm F * bool_dist_wrt G gG
   + bool_dist_wrt F gF * l1_norm (embed gG).

items.name: BoolFormula
items.statement:
Inductive BoolFormula (n : nat) : Type :=
  | BVar   : Fin.t n -> BoolFormula n                          
  | BConst : bool -> BoolFormula n                             
  | BAnd   : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n
  | BOr    : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n
  | BNot   : BoolFormula n -> BoolFormula n.

items.name: eval_bf
items.statement:
Fixpoint eval_bf {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) (c : Corner n) : bool :=
  match phi with
  | BVar i     => match Vector.nth c i with Pos => true | Neg => false end
  | BConst b   => b
  | BAnd p q   => andb (eval_bf p c) (eval_bf q c)
  | BOr p q    => orb (eval_bf p c) (eval_bf q c)
  | BNot p     => negb (eval_bf p c)
  end.

items.name: translate
items.statement:
Fixpoint translate {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : GA_expr n :=
  match phi with
  | BVar i       => Mul (Scalar (1#2)) (Add (Scalar 1) (Basis i))
  | BConst true  => Scalar 1
  | BConst false => Scalar 0
  | BAnd p q     => Conv (translate p) (translate q)             
  | BNot p       => Add (Scalar 1) (Mul (Scalar (-1)) (translate p))
  | BOr p q      => Add (Add (translate p) (translate q))
                         (Mul (Scalar (-1)) (Conv (translate p) (translate q)))
  end.

items.name: mask_xor_self
items.statement: Lemma mask_xor_self : forall n (A : Mask n), mask_xor A A = mask_empty.

items.name: xorb_eq_false_implies_eq
items.statement: Lemma xorb_eq_false_implies_eq : forall a b : bool, xorb a b = false -> a = b.

items.name: VectorDef_nth_const

Lemma mask_xor_eq_empty_iff : forall n (A B : Mask n),

items.name: sumQ_swap
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_swap :
  forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B -> Q) (la : list A) (lb : list B),
    sumQ (List.map (fun a => sumQ (List.map (fun b => f a b) lb)) la)
    == sumQ (List.map (fun b => sumQ (List.map (fun a => f a b) la)) lb).

items.name: corner_walsh_sum
items.statement:
Definition corner_walsh_sum {n} (m1 m2 : Mask n) : Q :=
  sumQ (List.map (fun s => (chi' m1 s * chi' m2 s)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: corner_walsh_sum_via_xor
items.statement:
Lemma corner_walsh_sum_via_xor :
  forall n (m1 m2 : Mask n),
    corner_walsh_sum m1 m2
    == sumQ (List.map (fun s => chi' (mask_xor m1 m2) s) (all_corners n)).

items.name: chi_corner_sum_empty
items.statement:
Lemma chi_corner_sum_empty :
  forall n,
    sumQ (List.map (fun s => chi' (mask_empty (n:=n)) s) (all_corners n))
    == pow2 n.

items.name: chi_corner_sum_nonempty
items.statement:
Lemma chi_corner_sum_nonempty :
  forall n (m : Mask n),
    m <> mask_empty ->
    sumQ (List.map (fun s => chi' m s) (all_corners n)) == 0.

items.name: corner_walsh_sum_closed
items.statement:
Lemma corner_walsh_sum_closed :
  forall n (m1 m2 : Mask n),
    corner_walsh_sum m1 m2
    == (if mask_eq_dec m1 m2 then pow2 n else 0).

items.name: Qminus_diag'
items.statement: Lemma Qminus_diag' (x : Q) : (x - x)%Q == 0%Q.

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick_Q
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick_Q :
  forall n (f : Mask n -> Q) (U : Mask n) (k : Q),
    sumQ (List.map (fun m => if mask_eq_dec m U then (f m * k)%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n))
    == (f U * k)%Q.

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick_const_Q
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick_const_Q :
  forall n (U : Mask n) (a : Q),
    sumQ (List.map (fun m => if mask_eq_dec m U then a else 0%Q) (all_masks n))
    == a.

items.name: Qeq_plus_r
items.statement: Lemma Qeq_plus_r : forall a b c : Q, a == b -> (a + c)%Q == (b + c)%Q.

items.name: eval_extensionality
items.statement:
Lemma eval_extensionality :
  forall n (F G : MV n),
    (forall s : Corner n, eval F s == eval G s) ->
    forall m : Mask n, F m == G m.

items.name: chi_mask_empty
items.statement:
Lemma chi_mask_empty :
  forall n (s : Corner n),
    chi' (mask_empty (n:=n)) s == 1%Q.

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick_chi
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick_chi :
  forall n (s : Corner n),
    sumQ (List.map (fun m0 : Mask n =>
      ((if mask_eq_dec m0 mask_empty then 1%Q else 0%Q) * chi' m0 s)%Q)
      (all_masks n))
    == 1%Q.

items.name: embed_const_true
items.statement:
Lemma embed_const_true : forall n (m : Mask n),
  embed (fun _ : Corner n => true) m == mv_one m.

items.name: eval_basis
items.statement:
Lemma eval_basis : forall n (M : Mask n) (s : Corner n),

items.name: eval_mv_one

Lemma eval_mv_one : forall n (s : Corner n),

items.name: corner_walsh_sum_ortho
items.statement:
Lemma corner_walsh_sum_ortho : forall n (A B : Mask n),
  sumQ (List.map (fun s => (chi' A s * chi' B s)%Q) (all_corners n))
  == if mask_eq_dec A B then pow2 n else 0%Q.

items.name: chi_mask_single
items.statement:
Lemma chi_mask_single :
  forall n (i : Fin.t n) (s : Corner n),
    chi' (mask_single i) s == sQ (Vector.nth s i).

items.name: eval_var_projector
items.statement:
Lemma eval_var_projector :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i : Fin.t n) (s : Corner n),
    (forall j, Vector.nth sq j == 1) ->
    eval (eval_expr sq (Mul (Scalar (1#2)) (Add (Scalar 1) (Basis i)))) s

items.name: bQ_negb_rhs
items.statement:
Lemma bQ_negb_rhs :

items.name: translate_eval_correct
items.statement:
Lemma translate_eval_correct :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n),
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    forall s : Corner n,

items.statement:
Theorem translate_correct : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n),
  (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
  forall m, eval_expr sq (translate phi) m == embed (eval_bf phi) m.

items.name: bf_varcount
items.statement:
Fixpoint bf_varcount {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : nat :=
  match phi with
  | BVar _      => 1%nat
  | BConst _    => 0%nat
  | BAnd p q    => (bf_varcount p + bf_varcount q)%nat
  | BOr  p q    => (bf_varcount p + bf_varcount q)%nat
  | BNot p      => bf_varcount p
  end.

items.name: grade_bound_translate_eq_varcount
items.statement:
Lemma grade_bound_translate_eq_varcount :
  forall n (phi : BoolFormula n),
    grade_bound (translate phi) = bf_varcount phi.

items.name: translate_excursion_upper
items.statement:
Theorem translate_excursion_upper :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n),
    (max_grade_during sq (translate phi) <= bf_varcount phi)%nat.

items.name: parity_varcount_lower_bound
items.statement:
Corollary parity_varcount_lower_bound :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n),
    (n > 0)%nat ->
    eval_expr sq (translate phi) = embed (@XOR_n_func n) ->
    (bf_varcount phi >= n)%nat.

items.name: parity_varcount_lower_bound_semantic
items.statement:
Corollary parity_varcount_lower_bound_semantic :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n),
    (n > 0)%nat ->
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = @XOR_n_func n ->
    (bf_varcount phi >= n)%nat.

items.name: sumQ_map_all_zero
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_all_zero :
  forall (A : Type) (f : A -> Q) (l : list A),
    (forall x, List.In x l -> f x == 0%Q) ->

items.name: sumQ_map_exists_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_exists_nonzero :
  forall (A : Type) (f : A -> Q) (l : list A),
    ~(sumQ (List.map f l) == 0%Q) ->
    exists x, List.In x l /\ ~(f x == 0%Q).

items.name: supp
items.statement:
Definition supp {n} (F : MV n) : Mask n -> Prop :=
  fun m => ~(F m == 0%Q).

items.name: in_support
items.statement:
Definition in_support {n} (F : MV n) (m : Mask n) : Prop :=
  ~(F m == 0).

items.name: supp_union
items.statement:
Definition supp_union {n} (S T : Mask n -> Prop) : Mask n -> Prop :=
  fun m => S m \/ T m.

items.name: supp_xor
conv_support_witness
items.statement:
Lemma conv_support_witness :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    in_support (mv_conv F G) U ->
    exists A B,
      List.In A (all_masks n) /\
      List.In B (all_masks n) /\
      mask_xor A B = U /\
      in_support F A /\
      in_support G B.

items.name: support_conv_subset_xor
items.statement:
Lemma support_conv_subset_xor :
  forall n (F G : MV n) U,
    supp (mv_conv F G) U ->
    supp_xor (supp F) (supp G) U.

items.name: supp_scale

Lemma supp_scale :
  forall n (c : Q) (F : MV n) m,

items.name: supp_add

Lemma supp_add :
  forall n (F G : MV n) m,
    supp (mv_add F G) m ->
    supp F m \/ supp G m.

items.name: supp_basis_only
items.statement:
Lemma supp_basis_only :
  forall n (m0 m : Mask n),
    supp (basis m0) m ->
    m = m0.

items.name: supp_mv_one_only_empty

Lemma supp_mv_one_only_empty :

    supp (@mv_one n) m ->
    m = mask_empty.

items.name: supp_bound_noMul
items.statement:
Fixpoint supp_bound_noMul {n} (e : GA_expr n) : Mask n -> Prop :=
  match e with
  | Basis i    => fun m => m = mask_single i
  | Scalar _   => fun m => m = mask_empty
  | Add e1 e2  => supp_union (supp_bound_noMul e1) (supp_bound_noMul e2)
  | Conv e1 e2 => supp_xor (supp_bound_noMul e1) (supp_bound_noMul e2)
  | Mul _ _    => fun _ => True
  end.

items.name: supp_bound
items.statement:
Fixpoint supp_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : Mask n -> Prop :=
  match e with
  | Basis i    => fun m => m = mask_single i
  | Scalar _   => fun m => m = mask_empty
  | Add e1 e2  => supp_union (supp_bound e1) (supp_bound e2)
  | Conv e1 e2 => supp_xor (supp_bound e1) (supp_bound e2)
  | Mul e1 e2  =>
      match e1, e2 with
      | Scalar _, _ => supp_bound e2
      | _, Scalar _ => supp_bound e1
      | _, _        => fun _ => True
      end
  end.

items.name: eval_support_within_bound_noMul
items.statement:
Theorem eval_support_within_bound_noMul :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) m,

    supp_bound_noMul (translate phi) m.

Lemma gp_support_witness :

    exists A B,

items.name: eval_support_within_bound

Theorem eval_support_within_bound :

items.name: Qmax
items.statement:
Definition Qmax (a b : Q) : Q :=
  if Qle_bool a b then b else a.

items.name: Qmax_l
items.statement: Lemma Qmax_l : forall a b, a <= Qmax a b.

items.name: Qmax_r
items.statement: Lemma Qmax_r : forall a b, b <= Qmax a b.

items.name: list_Qmax
items.statement:
Fixpoint list_Qmax (xs : list Q) : Q :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: tl => Qmax x (list_Qmax tl)
  end.

items.name: max_l1_during
items.statement:
Fixpoint max_l1_during {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) : Q :=
  match e with
  | Basis _   => 1
  | Scalar c  => Qabs c
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      max_l1_during sq e1 + max_l1_during sq e2
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      Qmax (Qmax (max_l1_during sq e1) (max_l1_during sq e2))
           (l1_norm (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)))
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      Qmax (Qmax (max_l1_during sq e1) (max_l1_during sq e2))
           (l1_norm (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)))
  end.

items.name: l1_eval_le_max_l1_during
items.statement:
Lemma l1_eval_le_max_l1_during :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
    l1_norm (eval_expr sq e) <= max_l1_during sq e.

items.name: dist_to
items.statement:
Definition dist_to {n} (F : MV n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Q :=
  bool_dist_wrt F f.

items.name: boolish_le
items.statement:
Definition boolish_le {n} (F : MV n) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  exists g : Corner n -> bool, bool_dist_wrt F g <= d.

items.name: max_booldist_during
items.statement:
Fixpoint max_booldist_during {n}
  (sq : Vector.t Q n)
  (f  : Corner n -> bool)
  (e  : GA_expr n) : Q :=
  match e with
  | Basis _  => dist_to (eval_expr sq e) f
  | Scalar _ => dist_to (eval_expr sq e) f
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      Qmax
        (Qmax (max_booldist_during sq f e1)
              (max_booldist_during sq f e2))
        (dist_to (eval_expr sq (Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2)) f)
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      Qmax
        (Qmax (max_booldist_during sq f e1)
              (max_booldist_during sq f e2))
        (dist_to (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) f)
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      Qmax
        (Qmax (max_booldist_during sq f e1)
              (max_booldist_during sq f e2))
        (dist_to (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) f)
  end.

items.name: booldist_eval_le_max_booldist_during
items.statement:
Lemma booldist_eval_le_max_booldist_during :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) (e : GA_expr n),
    dist_to (eval_expr sq e) f <= max_booldist_during sq f e.

items.name: trace_boolish_le
items.statement:
Fixpoint trace_boolish_le {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | Basis _ | Scalar _ => boolish_le (eval_expr sq e) d
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_le sq e1 d /\ trace_boolish_le sq e2 d /\
      boolish_le (eval_expr sq (Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2)) d
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_le sq e1 d /\ trace_boolish_le sq e2 d /\
      boolish_le (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) d
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_le sq e1 d /\ trace_boolish_le sq e2 d /\
      boolish_le (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) d
  end.

items.name: ExcNum
exc_of
exc_le
items.statement:
Definition exc_le (a b : ExcNum) : Prop :=
  (exc_grade a < exc_grade b)%nat \/
  (exc_grade a = exc_grade b /\ exc_l1 a < exc_l1 b) \/
  (exc_grade a = exc_grade b /\ exc_l1 a == exc_l1 b).

items.name: exc_pre
items.statement:
Definition exc_pre (a b : ExcNum) : Prop :=
  (exc_grade a <= exc_grade b)%nat /\ exc_l1 a <= exc_l1 b.

items.name: computes

items.name: expr_size
items.statement:
Fixpoint expr_size {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Basis _ => 1
  | Scalar _ => 1
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 => 1 + expr_size e1 + expr_size e2
  | Mul e1 e2 => 1 + expr_size e1 + expr_size e2
  | Conv e1 e2 => 1 + expr_size e1 + expr_size e2
  end.

items.name: easy_under
items.statement:
Definition easy_under (B : nat -> ExcNum) (d : Q)
  {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  exists e : GA_expr n,
    computes sq e f /\
    exc_pre (exc_of sq e) (B (expr_size e)) /\
    trace_boolish_le sq e d.

items.name: hard_under

  {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (f : Corner n -> bool) : Prop :=
  forall e : GA_expr n,
    computes sq e f ->
    ~ (exc_pre (exc_of sq e) (B (expr_size e)) /\ trace_boolish_le sq e d).

items.name: lincomb_embed
items.statement:
Fixpoint lincomb_embed {n}
  (cs : list Q) (gs : list (Corner n -> bool)) : MV n :=
  match cs, gs with
  | [], [] => mv_zero
  | c :: cs', g :: gs' =>
      mv_add (mv_scale c (embed g)) (lincomb_embed cs' gs')
  | _, _ => mv_zero                                                  
  end.

    wf_lincomb cs gs /\

    l1_norm (mv_sub F (lincomb_embed cs gs)) <= d.

items.name: trace_boolish_k_le
items.statement:
Fixpoint trace_boolish_k_le {n}
  (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) (k : nat) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | Basis _ | Scalar _ => boolish_k_le (eval_expr sq e) k d
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_k_le sq e1 k d /\
      trace_boolish_k_le sq e2 k d /\
      boolish_k_le (eval_expr sq (Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2)) k d
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_k_le sq e1 k d /\
      trace_boolish_k_le sq e2 k d /\
      boolish_k_le (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) k d
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      trace_boolish_k_le sq e1 k d /\
      trace_boolish_k_le sq e2 k d /\
      boolish_k_le (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)) k d
  end.

items.name: poly1
items.statement:
Definition poly1 (n : nat) (a c : nat) : nat :=
  c * Nat.pow (n + 1) a.

items.name: poly_bound1
items.statement:
Definition poly_bound1 (f : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  exists a c,
    forall n, (f n <= poly1 n a c)%nat.

items.name: poly_in_nat
items.statement:
Definition poly_in_nat (s x : nat) (a b c : nat) : nat :=
  c * (Nat.pow (s + 1) a) * (Nat.pow (x + 1) b).

items.name: poly_bound2
items.statement:
Definition poly_bound2 (P : nat -> nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  exists (a b c : nat),
    forall (s x : nat),
      (P s x <= poly_in_nat s x a b c)%nat.

items.name: dominates_poly
items.statement:
Definition dominates_poly (f : nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall a c,
    exists N, forall n, (n >= N)%nat ->
      (poly1 n a c < f n)%nat.

items.name: dominates_poly2
items.statement:
Definition dominates_poly2 (F : nat -> nat -> nat) : Prop :=
  forall a b c,
    exists N, forall s x,
      (s >= N)%nat ->
      (poly_in_nat s x a b c < F s x)%nat.

items.name: superpoly
items.statement: Definition superpoly (f : nat -> nat) : Prop := dominates_poly f.

items.name: exp_lb

items.name: pow_le_succ

Lemma pow_s_mono :

Lemma pow_x_mono :

items.statement: Lemma pow2_ge_1 : forall n, 1 <= pow2 n.

items.name: pow2_le_mono
items.statement: Lemma pow2_le_mono : forall a b, (a <= b)%nat -> pow2 a <= pow2 b.

items.name: embed_IP_abs_lower
items.statement:
Lemma embed_IP_abs_lower : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)),
  (m >= 1)%nat ->
  1 / pow2 (m + 1) <= Qabs (embed (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M).

items.name: sumQ_map_lower_bound
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_lower_bound :
  forall (A : Type) (f : A -> Q) (l : list A) (c : Q),
    (forall x, List.In x l -> c <= f x) ->
    (inject_Z (Z.of_nat (length l)) * c <= sumQ (List.map f l))%Q.

items.name: l1_norm_embed_IP_lower_bound
items.statement:
Theorem l1_norm_embed_IP_lower_bound : forall m,
  (m >= 2)%nat ->
  (pow2 (m - 1) <= l1_norm (embed (@IP_n_func (m + m))))%Q.

items.name: trace_boolish_exists_k
size_expr
items.statement:
Fixpoint size_expr {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Basis _ | Scalar _ => 1
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 => 1 + size_expr e1 + size_expr e2
  | Mul e1 e2 => 1 + size_expr e1 + size_expr e2
  | Conv e1 e2 => 1 + size_expr e1 + size_expr e2
  end.

items.name: trace_boolish_poly_size
trace_boolish_poly_n
trace_boolish_poly_size_implies_exists_k
items.statement:
Lemma trace_boolish_poly_size_implies_exists_k :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) d,
    trace_boolish_poly_size sq e d ->
    trace_boolish_exists_k sq e d.

items.name: trace_boolish_k_le_mono
items.statement:
Lemma trace_boolish_k_le_mono :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) k1 k2 d,
    (k1 <= k2)%nat ->
    trace_boolish_k_le sq e k1 d ->
    trace_boolish_k_le sq e k2 d.

items.name: trace_boolish_poly_size_to_k_le
items.statement:
Lemma trace_boolish_poly_size_to_k_le :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) d,
    trace_boolish_poly_size sq e d ->
    trace_boolish_k_le sq e (Nat.pow (size_expr e) 3) d.

items.name: IP_exponential_in_booleanish_model
items.statement:
Theorem IP_exponential_in_booleanish_model :
  forall d : Q,
  exists c : nat,
    forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m+m)) (e : GA_expr (m+m)),
      (m >= 2)%nat ->
      computes sq e (@IP_n_func (m+m)) ->
      trace_boolish_poly_size sq e d ->
      (Qpow2 (c * m) <= exc_l1 (exc_of sq e))%Q.

items.name: eval_bounded
items.statement:
Definition eval_bounded {n} (F : MV n) (C : Q) : Prop :=
  forall s : Corner n, Qabs (eval F s) <= C.

items.name: eval_close_bool
items.statement:
Definition eval_close_bool {n} (F : MV n) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  exists g : Corner n -> bool,
    forall s : Corner n, Qabs (eval F s - bQ (g s)) <= d.

items.name: Qabs_sQ_1
items.statement: Lemma Qabs_sQ_1 : forall h : Sign, Qabs (sQ h) == 1.

items.name: Qabs_chi'_1
items.statement:
Lemma Qabs_chi'_1 :
  forall n (m : Mask n) (s : Corner n),
    Qabs (chi' m s) == 1.

items.name: eval_abs_le_l1
items.statement:
Lemma eval_abs_le_l1 :
  forall n (F : MV n) (s : Corner n),
    Qabs (eval F s) <= l1_norm F.

items.name: bool_dist_le_implies_eval_close
items.statement:
Lemma bool_dist_le_implies_eval_close :
  forall n (F : MV n) (d : Q),
    bool_dist_le F d -> eval_close_bool F d.

items.name: Qabs_bQ_le_1
items.statement: Lemma Qabs_bQ_le_1 : forall b : bool, Qabs (bQ b) <= 1.

items.name: eval_close_bool_implies_eval_bounded_1pd
items.statement:
Lemma eval_close_bool_implies_eval_bounded_1pd :
  forall n (F : MV n) (d : Q),
    eval_close_bool F d ->
    eval_bounded F (1 + d).

items.name: sumQ_mul_r
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_mul_r :
  forall (A : Type) (f : A -> Q) (k : Q) (l : list A),
    (sumQ (List.map f l) * k)%Q == sumQ (List.map (fun x => (f x * k)%Q) l).

items.name: coeff_via_eval
items.statement:
Lemma coeff_via_eval :
  forall n (F : MV n) (m : Mask n),
    F m ==
    (1 / pow2 n) *
      sumQ (List.map (fun s => (eval F s * chi' m s)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: Qlt_0_1'
items.statement: Lemma Qlt_0_1' : (0 < 1)%Q.

items.name: Qlt_0_2'
items.statement: Lemma Qlt_0_2' : (0 < 2)%Q.

items.name: pow2_Qpos
items.statement: Lemma pow2_Qpos : forall n, (0 < pow2 n)%Q.

items.name: Qmult_le_compat_l'
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_le_compat_l' : forall c a b : Q,
  0 <= c ->
  a <= b ->
  c * a <= c * b.

items.name: abs_coeff_le_avg_abs_eval
items.statement:
Lemma abs_coeff_le_avg_abs_eval :
  forall n (F : MV n) (m : Mask n),
    Qabs (F m) <=
      (1 / pow2 n) *
        sumQ (List.map (fun s => Qabs (eval F s)) (all_corners n)).

items.name: sumQ_const_all_masks
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_const_all_masks :
  forall n (k : Q),
    sumQ (List.map (fun _ : Mask n => k) (all_masks n)) == pow2 n * k.

items.name: Qdiv_mul_cancel_l
items.statement:
Lemma Qdiv_mul_cancel_l :
  forall (q r : Q),
    ~ q == 0 ->
    (1 / q) * (q * r) == r.

items.name: l1_le_sum_abs_eval
items.statement:
Lemma l1_le_sum_abs_eval :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    l1_norm F <=
      sumQ (List.map (fun s => Qabs (eval F s)) (all_corners n)).

items.name: sumQ_const_all_corners
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_const_all_corners :
  forall n (k : Q),
    sumQ (List.map (fun _ : Corner n => k) (all_corners n)) == pow2 n * k.

items.name: sum_abs_eval_le_pow2C
items.statement:
Lemma sum_abs_eval_le_pow2C :
  forall n (F : MV n) (C : Q),
    eval_bounded F C ->
    sumQ (List.map (fun s => Qabs (eval F s)) (all_corners n)) <= (pow2 n) * C.

items.name: eval_bounded_implies_l1_bound
items.statement:
Theorem eval_bounded_implies_l1_bound :
  forall n (F : MV n) (C : Q),
    eval_bounded F C ->
    l1_norm F <= (pow2 n) * C.

items.name: sum_abs_eval_le_pow2_l1
items.statement:
Lemma sum_abs_eval_le_pow2_l1 :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    sumQ (map (fun s => Qabs (eval F s)) (all_corners n))
    <= (pow2 n) * l1_norm F.

items.name: eval_bounded_by_l1
items.statement:
Corollary eval_bounded_by_l1 :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    eval_bounded F (l1_norm F).

items.name: l1_and_sum_abs_eval_equiv
items.statement:
Theorem l1_and_sum_abs_eval_equiv :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    l1_norm F <= sumQ (map (fun s => Qabs (eval F s)) (all_corners n))
    /\
    sumQ (map (fun s => Qabs (eval F s)) (all_corners n))
      <= pow2 n * l1_norm F.

items.name: chi_xor_mul
items.statement:
Lemma chi_xor_mul :
  forall n (A B : Mask n) (s : Corner n),
    chi' (mask_xor A B) s == (chi' A s * chi' B s)%Q.

items.name: if_dec_0_mul
items.statement:
Lemma if_dec_0_mul :
  forall (P : Prop) (d : {P}+{~P}) (a b : Q),
    (if d then a else 0) * b == if d then a * b else 0.

items.name: if_mask_eq_dec_subst
items.statement:
Lemma if_mask_eq_dec_subst :
  forall n (X U : Mask n) (f : Mask n -> Q) (b : Q),
    (if mask_eq_dec X U then f U else b)
    == (if mask_eq_dec X U then f X else b).

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick'
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick' :
  forall n (f : Mask n -> Q) (tgt : Mask n),
    sumQ (map (fun m => if mask_eq_dec m tgt then f m else 0) (all_masks n))
    == f tgt.

items.name: eval_conv_pointwise
items.statement:
Lemma eval_conv_pointwise :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (mv_conv F G) s == (eval F s * eval G s)%Q.

items.name: eval_abs_le_bound
items.statement:
Lemma eval_abs_le_bound :
  forall n (F:MV n) (C:Q) s, eval_bounded F C -> Qabs (eval F s) <= C.

items.name: eval_bounded_conv
items.statement:
Lemma eval_bounded_conv :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (CF CG : Q),
    eval_bounded F CF -> eval_bounded G CG ->
    eval_bounded (mv_conv F G) (CF * CG).

items.name: eval_sub_pointwise
items.statement:
Lemma eval_sub_pointwise :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (mv_sub F G) s == (eval F s - eval G s)%Q.

items.name: Qabs_triangle_sub
items.statement:
Lemma Qabs_triangle_sub : forall x y : Q,
  Qabs (x - y) <= Qabs x + Qabs y.

items.name: eval_bounded_sub
items.statement:
Lemma eval_bounded_sub :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (CF CG : Q),
    eval_bounded F CF ->
    eval_bounded G CG ->
    eval_bounded (mv_sub F G) (CF + CG).

items.name: eval_add_pointwise
items.statement:
Lemma eval_add_pointwise :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (mv_add F G) s == (eval F s + eval G s)%Q.

items.name: eval_bounded_add
items.statement:
Lemma eval_bounded_add :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (CF CG : Q),
    eval_bounded F CF ->
    eval_bounded G CG ->
    eval_bounded (mv_add F G) (CF + CG).

items.name: eval_scale_pointwise
items.statement:
Lemma eval_scale_pointwise :
  forall n (c : Q) (F : MV n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (mv_scale c F) s == c * eval F s.

items.name: eval_bounded_scale
items.statement:
Lemma eval_bounded_scale :
  forall n (c : Q) (F : MV n) (C : Q),
    eval_bounded F C ->
    eval_bounded (mv_scale c F) (Qabs c * C).

items.name: eval_close_bool'
items.statement:
Definition eval_close_bool' {n} (F : MV n) (d : Q) : Prop :=
  exists g : Corner n -> bool,
    forall s, Qabs (eval F s - bQ (g s)) <= d.

items.name: bQ_andb_mul
items.statement:
Lemma bQ_andb_mul : forall a b : bool,
  bQ (andb a b) == (bQ a * bQ b)%Q.

items.name: corner_pos
items.statement:
Fixpoint corner_pos (n : nat) : Corner n :=
  match n with
  | O => Vector.nil Sign
  | S n' => Vector.cons Sign (Pos : Sign) n' (corner_pos n')
  end.

items.name: eval_close_bool_nonneg
items.statement:
Lemma eval_close_bool_nonneg :
  forall n (F : MV n) d,
    eval_close_bool F d -> 0 <= d.

items.name: Qabs_triangle3
items.statement:
Lemma Qabs_triangle3 : forall x y z : Q,
  Qabs (x + y + z) <= Qabs x + Qabs y + Qabs z.

items.name: eval_close_bool_conv
items.statement:
Lemma eval_close_bool_conv :
  forall n (F G : MV n) dF dG,
    eval_close_bool F dF ->
    eval_close_bool G dG ->
    eval_close_bool (mv_conv F G) (dF + dG + dF*dG).

items.name: constMV
items.statement:
Definition constMV {n} (c : Q) : MV n :=
  mv_scale c (basis mask_empty).

items.name: eval_constMV
items.statement:
Lemma eval_constMV :
  forall n (c : Q) (s : Corner n),
    eval (@constMV n c) s == c.

items.name: eval_close_bool_not
items.statement:
Lemma eval_close_bool_not :
  forall n (F : MV n) d,
    eval_close_bool F d ->
    eval_close_bool (mv_sub (constMV 1) F) d.

items.name: bQ_orb_mul
items.statement:
Lemma bQ_orb_mul : forall a b : bool,
  bQ (orb a b) == (bQ a + bQ b - bQ a * bQ b)%Q.

items.name: Qabs_1_minus_bQ_le_1
items.statement: Lemma Qabs_1_minus_bQ_le_1 : forall b : bool, Qabs (1 - bQ b) <= 1.

items.name: eval_close_bool_or
items.statement:
Lemma eval_close_bool_or :
  forall n (F G : MV n) dF dG,
    eval_close_bool F dF ->
    eval_close_bool G dG ->
    eval_close_bool
      (mv_sub (mv_add F G) (mv_conv F G))
      (dF + dG + dF * dG).

items.name: Lit
items.statement: Definition Lit (n : nat) := (Fin.t n * bool)%type.

items.name: Clause
items.statement: Definition Clause (n : nat) := list (Lit n).

items.name: CNF
items.statement: Definition CNF (n : nat) := list (Clause n).

items.name: chiMV
items.statement:
Definition chiMV {n} (i : Fin.t n) : MV n :=
  basis (mask_single i).

items.name: varMV
items.statement:
Definition varMV {n} (i : Fin.t n) : MV n :=
    mv_scale (1#2) (mv_add (constMV 1) (chiMV i)).

items.name: mv_not
items.statement:
Definition mv_not (F : MV n) : MV n :=
    mv_sub (constMV 1) F.

items.name: mv_and
items.statement:
Definition mv_and (F G : MV n) : MV n :=
    mv_conv F G.

items.name: mv_or
items.statement:
Definition mv_or (F G : MV n) : MV n :=
    mv_sub (mv_add F G) (mv_conv F G).

items.name: compile_lit
items.statement:
Definition compile_lit (l : Lit n) : MV n :=
    let '(i, neg) := l in
    if neg then mv_not (varMV i) else varMV i.

items.name: compile_clause
items.statement:
Fixpoint compile_clause (c : Clause n) : MV n :=
    match c with
    | [] => constMV 0
    | l :: cs => mv_or (compile_lit l) (compile_clause cs)
    end.

items.name: compile_cnf
items.statement:
Fixpoint compile_cnf (phi : CNF n) : MV n :=
    match phi with
    | [] => constMV 1
    | c :: cs => mv_and (compile_clause c) (compile_cnf cs)
    end.

items.name: eval_chiMV
items.statement:
Lemma eval_chiMV :
  forall n (i : Fin.t n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (@chiMV n i) s == chi' (mask_single i) s.

items.name: chi_single_is_sQ
items.statement:
Lemma chi_single_is_sQ :
  forall n (i : Fin.t n) (s : Corner n),
    chi' (mask_single i) s == sQ (Vector.nth s i).

items.name: bQ_corner_bit
items.statement:
Lemma bQ_corner_bit :
  forall h : Sign,
    bQ (sign_to_bool h) == (1#2) * (1 + sQ h).

items.name: corner_bit
items.statement:
Definition corner_bit {n} (i : Fin.t n) (s : Corner n) : bool :=
  sign_to_bool (Vector.nth s i).

items.name: bQ_sign_to_bool_plus
items.statement:
Lemma bQ_sign_to_bool_plus :
  forall h : Sign,
    bQ (match h with Pos => true | Neg => false end)
    == (1#2) * (1 + sQ h).

items.name: eval_varMV
items.statement:
Lemma eval_varMV :
  forall n (i : Fin.t n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (@varMV n i) s == bQ (corner_bit i s).

items.name: eval_close_bool_varMV
items.statement:
Lemma eval_close_bool_varMV :
  forall n (i : Fin.t n),
    eval_close_bool (@varMV n i) 0.

items.name: eval_close_bool_const0
items.statement: Lemma eval_close_bool_const0 : forall n, eval_close_bool (@constMV n 0) 0.

items.name: eval_close_bool_const1
items.statement: Lemma eval_close_bool_const1 : forall n, eval_close_bool (@constMV n 1) 0.

items.name: compile_lit_eval_close
items.statement:
Lemma compile_lit_eval_close :
  forall n (l : Lit n),
    eval_close_bool (compile_lit (n:=n) l) 0.

items.name: eval_close_bool_or_mv_or
items.statement:
Lemma eval_close_bool_or_mv_or :
  forall n (F G : MV n) dF dG,
    eval_close_bool F dF ->
    eval_close_bool G dG ->
    eval_close_bool (mv_or F G) (dF + dG + dF*dG).

items.name: compile_clause_eval_close
items.statement:
Lemma compile_clause_eval_close :
  forall n (c : Clause n),
    eval_close_bool (compile_clause (n:=n) c) 0.

items.name: compile_cnf_eval_close
items.statement:
Lemma compile_cnf_eval_close :
  forall n (phi : CNF n),
    eval_close_bool (compile_cnf (n:=n) phi) 0.

items.name: compile_cnf_eval_bounded
items.statement:
Corollary compile_cnf_eval_bounded :
  forall n (phi : CNF n),
    eval_bounded (compile_cnf (n:=n) phi) 1.

items.name: compile_cnf_l1_bound
items.statement:
Corollary compile_cnf_l1_bound :
  forall n (phi : CNF n),
    l1_norm (compile_cnf (n:=n) phi) <= pow2 n.

items.name: Qabs_le_0_eq
items.statement:
Lemma Qabs_le_0_eq :
  forall x : Q, Qabs x <= 0 -> x == 0.

items.name: eval_close_bool_0_implies_pointwise
items.statement:
Lemma eval_close_bool_0_implies_pointwise :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    eval_close_bool F 0 ->
    exists g : Corner n -> bool,
      forall s : Corner n, eval F s == bQ (g s).

items.name: compile_cnf_correct
items.statement:
Corollary compile_cnf_correct :
  forall n (phi : CNF n),
    exists g : Corner n -> bool,
      forall s : Corner n,
        eval (compile_cnf (n:=n) phi) s == bQ (g s).

items.name: eval_pointwise_eq_implies_coeff_eq
items.statement:
Lemma eval_pointwise_eq_implies_coeff_eq :
  forall n (F G : MV n),
    (forall s : Corner n, eval F s == eval G s) ->
    forall m : Mask n, F m == G m.

items.name: eval_eq_bQ_implies_coeff_eq_embed
items.statement:
Lemma eval_eq_bQ_implies_coeff_eq_embed :
  forall n (F : MV n) (f : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall s : Corner n, eval F s == bQ (f s)) ->
    forall m : Mask n, F m == embed f m.

items.name: compile_cnf_coeff_correct
items.statement:
Corollary compile_cnf_coeff_correct :
  forall n (phi : CNF n),
    exists g : Corner n -> bool,
      forall m : Mask n,
        (compile_cnf (n:=n) phi) m == embed g m.

items.name: cnf_exists_small_rep
items.statement:
Theorem cnf_exists_small_rep :
  forall n (phi : CNF n),
    exists F : MV n,
                      
      (exists g, forall s, eval F s == bQ (g s)) /\
      l1_norm F <= pow2 n.

items.name: bf_of_lit
items.statement:
Definition bf_of_lit {n} (l : Lit n) : BoolFormula n :=
  let '(i, neg) := l in
  if neg then BNot (BVar i) else BVar i.

items.name: bf_of_clause
items.statement:
Fixpoint bf_of_clause {n} (c : Clause n) : BoolFormula n :=
  match c with
  | [] => BConst false
  | l :: cs => BOr (bf_of_lit l) (bf_of_clause cs)
  end.

items.name: bf_of_cnf
items.statement:
Fixpoint bf_of_cnf {n} (phi : CNF n) : BoolFormula n :=
  match phi with
  | [] => BConst true
  | c :: cs => BAnd (bf_of_clause c) (bf_of_cnf cs)
  end.

items.name: lit_sem
items.statement:
Definition lit_sem {n} (l : Lit n) (s : Corner n) : bool :=
  let '(i, neg) := l in
  if neg then negb (corner_bit i s) else corner_bit i s.

items.name: clause_sem
items.statement:
Fixpoint clause_sem {n} (c : Clause n) (s : Corner n) : bool :=
  match c with
  | [] => false
  | l :: cs => orb (lit_sem l s) (clause_sem cs s)
  end.

items.name: cnf_sem
items.statement:
Fixpoint cnf_sem {n} (phi : CNF n) (s : Corner n) : bool :=
  match phi with
  | [] => true
  | c :: cs => andb (clause_sem c s) (cnf_sem cs s)
  end.

items.name: compile_cnf_expr
items.statement:
Definition compile_cnf_expr {n} (phi : CNF n) : GA_expr n :=
  translate (bf_of_cnf phi).

items.name: eval_mv_not
items.statement:
Lemma eval_mv_not :
  forall n (F : MV n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (mv_not (n:=n) F) s == (1 - eval F s)%Q.

items.name: eval_mv_or
items.statement:
Lemma eval_mv_or :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (mv_or (n:=n) F G) s
    == (eval F s + eval G s - eval (mv_conv F G) s)%Q.

items.name: eval_compile_lit
items.statement:
Lemma eval_compile_lit :
  forall n (l : Lit n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (compile_lit (n:=n) l) s == bQ (lit_sem l s).

items.name: eval_compile_clause
items.statement:
Lemma eval_compile_clause :
  forall n (c : Clause n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (compile_clause (n:=n) c) s == bQ (clause_sem c s).

items.name: compile_cnf_eval_correct
items.statement:
Lemma compile_cnf_eval_correct :
  forall n (phi : CNF n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (compile_cnf (n:=n) phi) s == bQ (cnf_sem (n:=n) phi s).

items.name: cnf_small_rep_correct
items.statement:
Theorem cnf_small_rep_correct :
  forall n (phi : CNF n),
    exists F : MV n,
      (forall s, eval F s == bQ (cnf_sem phi s)) /\
      l1_norm F <= pow2 n.

items.name: eval_bf_of_lit
items.statement:
Lemma eval_bf_of_lit :
  forall n (l : Lit n) (s : Corner n),
    eval_bf (bf_of_lit (n:=n) l) s = lit_sem (n:=n) l s.

items.name: eval_bf_of_clause
items.statement:
Lemma eval_bf_of_clause :
  forall n (c : Clause n) (s : Corner n),
    eval_bf (bf_of_clause (n:=n) c) s = clause_sem (n:=n) c s.

items.name: eval_bf_of_cnf
items.statement:
Lemma eval_bf_of_cnf :
  forall n (phi : CNF n) (s : Corner n),
    eval_bf (bf_of_cnf (n:=n) phi) s = cnf_sem (n:=n) phi s.

items.name: embed_ext
items.statement:
Lemma embed_ext :
  forall n (f g : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall s, f s = g s) ->
    forall m, embed (n:=n) f m == embed (n:=n) g m.

items.name: compile_cnf_expr_sound
items.statement:

  forall n (phi : CNF n) (sq : Vector.t Q n),
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    computes sq (compile_cnf_expr phi) (cnf_sem phi)
    /\
    (forall m, eval_expr sq (compile_cnf_expr phi) m == embed (cnf_sem phi) m).

      eval_expr sq (compile_cnf_expr phi) m

  exists f : forall n, Corner n -> bool,
  exists c : nat,
    forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
      computes sq e (f n) ->
      trace_boolish_exists_k sq e d ->

  forall d : Q,
  exists f : forall n, Corner n -> bool,
  exists c : nat,
    forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
      computes sq e (f n) ->
      ( trace_boolish_exists_k sq e d
        -> Qpow2 (c * Nat.div2 n) <= exc_l1 (exc_of sq e) ) /\
      ( ~ trace_boolish_exists_k sq e d
        ->                                                               
           True ).

Lemma gp_boolish_witness_error_only :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n) k d,
    (forall i : Fin.t n, Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1) ->
    boolish_k_le F k d ->
    boolish_k_le G k d ->
    exists LF LG,
      l1_norm (mv_sub F LF) <= d /\
      l1_norm (mv_sub G LG) <= d /\
      l1_norm (mv_sub (mv_gp sq F G) (mv_gp sq LF LG))
      <= l1_norm F * d + d * l1_norm LG.

items.name: dag_op
items.statement:
Inductive dag_op : nat -> Type :=
  | DOpBasis  : forall {k}, Fin.t n -> dag_op k
  | DOpScalar : forall {k}, Q -> dag_op k
  | DOpAdd    : forall {k}, Fin.t k -> Fin.t k -> dag_op k
  | DOpMul    : forall {k}, Fin.t k -> Fin.t k -> dag_op k
  | DOpConv   : forall {k}, Fin.t k -> Fin.t k -> dag_op k.

items.name: GA_dag
items.statement:
Inductive GA_dag : nat -> Type :=
  | DagNil  : GA_dag 0
  | DagSnoc : forall {k}, GA_dag k -> dag_op k -> GA_dag (S k).

items.name: dag_size
items.statement: Definition dag_size {k} (_ : GA_dag k) : nat := k.

items.name: eval_op
items.statement:
Definition eval_op (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k}
    (env : Fin.t k -> MV n) (op : dag_op k) : MV n :=
  match op with
  | DOpBasis _ i   => basis (mask_single i)
  | DOpScalar _ c  => constMV c
  | DOpAdd _ a b   => mv_add (env a) (env b)
  | DOpMul _ a b   => mv_gp sq (env a) (env b)
  | DOpConv _ a b  => mv_conv (env a) (env b)
  end.

items.name: eval_dag_env
items.statement:
Fixpoint eval_dag_env (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k)
    : Fin.t k -> MV n :=
  match d with
  | DagNil => fun i => Fin.case0 _ i
  | DagSnoc d' op =>
      let prev := eval_dag_env sq d' in
      let v := eval_op sq prev op in
      fun i =>
        match i in Fin.t (S k') return (Fin.t k' -> MV n) -> MV n -> MV n with
        | Fin.F1 => fun _ newest => newest
        | Fin.FS j => fun old _ => old j
        end prev v
  end.

items.name: eval_dag
items.statement:
Definition eval_dag (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k)
    (i : Fin.t k) : MV n :=
  eval_dag_env sq d i.

    eval_dag_env sq (DagSnoc d op) Fin.F1
    = eval_op sq (eval_dag_env sq d) op.

         (j : Fin.t k),
    eval_dag_env sq (DagSnoc d op) (Fin.FS j)
    = eval_dag_env sq d j.

items.name: dag_max_l1
items.statement:
Fixpoint dag_max_l1 (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k} (d : GA_dag k) : Q :=
  match d with
  | DagNil => 0
  | DagSnoc d' op =>
      Qmax (dag_max_l1 sq d')
           (l1_norm (eval_op sq (eval_dag_env sq d') op))
  end.

items.name: dag_max_grade

  | DagSnoc d' op =>

              (max_grade (eval_op sq (eval_dag_env sq d') op))
  end.

items.name: dag_trace_boolish

items.name: fin_weaken_by
items.statement:
Fixpoint fin_weaken_by (m : nat) {k} (i : Fin.t k)
    : Fin.t (m + k) :=
  match m with
  | 0 => i
  | S m' => Fin.FS (fin_weaken_by m' i)
  end.

items.name: fin_lift_into
items.statement:
Definition fin_lift_into (m : nat) {k} (i : Fin.t k)
    : Fin.t (k + m) :=
  Fin.L m i.

items.name: shift_op
items.statement:
Definition shift_op (m : nat) {k} (op : dag_op k) : dag_op (k + m) :=
  match op with
  | DOpBasis _ i   => DOpBasis i
  | DOpScalar _ c  => DOpScalar c
  | DOpAdd _ a b   => DOpAdd (fin_lift_into m a) (fin_lift_into m b)
  | DOpMul _ a b   => DOpMul (fin_lift_into m a) (fin_lift_into m b)
  | DOpConv _ a b  => DOpConv (fin_lift_into m a) (fin_lift_into m b)
  end.

items.name: fin_weaken_by_0
items.statement:
Lemma fin_weaken_by_0 :
  forall {k} (i : Fin.t k),
    fin_weaken_by 0 i = i.

items.name: fin_weaken_by_S
items.statement:
Lemma fin_weaken_by_S :
  forall (m : nat) {k} (i : Fin.t k),
    fin_weaken_by (S m) i = Fin.FS (fin_weaken_by m i).

items.name: dag_append
items.statement:
Fixpoint dag_append {k1 k2} (d1 : GA_dag k1) (d2 : GA_dag k2)
    : GA_dag (k2 + k1) :=
  match d2 with
  | DagNil => d1
  | DagSnoc d2' op =>
      DagSnoc (dag_append d1 d2') (shift_op k1 op)
  end.

items.name: eval_dag_append_left
items.statement:
Lemma eval_dag_append_left :
  forall (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k1 k2}
         (d1 : GA_dag k1) (d2 : GA_dag k2) (i : Fin.t k1),
    eval_dag sq (dag_append d1 d2) (fin_weaken_by k2 i)
    = eval_dag sq d1 i.

items.name: eval_dag_append_right
items.statement:
Lemma eval_dag_append_right :
  forall (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k1 k2}
         (d1 : GA_dag k1) (d2 : GA_dag k2) (j : Fin.t k2),
    eval_dag sq (dag_append d1 d2) (fin_lift_into k1 j)
    = eval_dag sq d2 j.

items.name: dag_trace_boolish_append
items.statement:
Lemma dag_trace_boolish_append :
  forall (sq : Vector.t Q n) {k1 k2}
         (d1 : GA_dag k1) (d2 : GA_dag k2) tol,
    dag_trace_boolish sq (dag_append d1 d2) tol

items.name: flatten
items.statement:
Fixpoint flatten (e : GA_expr n)
    : { k : nat & GA_dag (S k) * Fin.t (S k) }%type :=
  match e with
  | Basis i =>
      existT _ 0
        (DagSnoc DagNil (DOpBasis i), Fin.F1)

  | Scalar c =>
      existT _ 0
        (DagSnoc DagNil (DOpScalar c), Fin.F1)

  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 =>
      let '(existT _ k1 (d1, r1)) := flatten e1 in
      let '(existT _ k2 (d2, r2)) := flatten e2 in
      let combined := dag_append d1 d2 in
      let r1' := fin_weaken_by (S k2) r1 in
      let r2' := fin_lift_into (S k1) r2 in
      existT _ (S k2 + S k1)
        (DagSnoc combined (DOpAdd r1' r2'), Fin.F1)
                                 
                                                     
      

  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      let '(existT _ k1 (d1, r1)) := flatten e1 in
      let '(existT _ k2 (d2, r2)) := flatten e2 in
      let combined := dag_append d1 d2 in
      let r1' := fin_weaken_by (S k2) r1 in
      let r2' := fin_lift_into (S k1) r2 in
      existT _ (S k2 + S k1)
        (DagSnoc combined (DOpMul r1' r2'), Fin.F1)
                                 
                                                     
      

  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      let '(existT _ k1 (d1, r1)) := flatten e1 in
      let '(existT _ k2 (d2, r2)) := flatten e2 in
      let combined := dag_append d1 d2 in
      let r1' := fin_weaken_by (S k2) r1 in
      let r2' := fin_lift_into (S k1) r2 in
      existT _ (S k2 + S k1)
        (DagSnoc combined (DOpConv r1' r2'), Fin.F1)
                                 
                                                      
      
  end.

items.name: unfold_node
items.statement:
Fixpoint unfold_node {k} (d : GA_dag k) (i : Fin.t k)
    : GA_expr n :=
  match d with
  | DagNil => Fin.case0 _ i
  | DagSnoc d' op =>
      match i with
      | Fin.F1 =>
          match op with
          | DOpBasis _ j   => Basis j
          | DOpScalar _ c  => Scalar c
          | DOpAdd _ a b   => Cln_Grade.Add (unfold_node d' a)
                                             (unfold_node d' b)
          | DOpMul _ a b   => Mul (unfold_node d' a)
                                   (unfold_node d' b)
          | DOpConv _ a b  => Conv (unfold_node d' a)
                                    (unfold_node d' b)
          end
      | Fin.FS j => unfold_node d' j
      end
  end.

    (forall k (d : GA_dag (S k)) (r : Fin.t (S k)),

items.name: dag_not
items.statement:
Definition dag_not {k} (d : GA_dag k) (r : Fin.t k)
    : GA_dag (S (S (S k))) :=
  let d1 := DagSnoc d (DOpScalar 1) in                                     
  let d2 := DagSnoc d1 (DOpScalar (-1)) in                                    
  let r_shifted := Fin.FS (Fin.FS r) in                                   
  let d3 := DagSnoc d2 (DOpMul Fin.F1 r_shifted) in                         
  d3.

items.name: dag_not_full
items.statement:
Definition dag_not_full {k} (d : GA_dag k) (r : Fin.t k)
    : { d' : GA_dag (S (S (S (S k)))) & Fin.t (S (S (S (S k)))) } :=
  let d1 := DagSnoc d  (DOpScalar 1) in
  let d2 := DagSnoc d1 (DOpScalar (-1)) in
  let r2 := Fin.FS (Fin.FS r) in
  let d3 := DagSnoc d2 (DOpMul Fin.F1 r2) in
  let one_ref := Fin.FS (Fin.FS Fin.F1) in
  let d4 := DagSnoc d3 (DOpAdd one_ref Fin.F1) in
  existT _ d4 Fin.F1.

items.name: dag_and
items.statement:
Definition dag_and {k} (d : GA_dag k)
    (rx ry : Fin.t k) : { d' : GA_dag (S k) & Fin.t (S k) } :=
  existT _ (DagSnoc d (DOpConv rx ry)) Fin.F1.

items.name: dag_or
items.statement:
Definition dag_or {k} (d : GA_dag k)
    (rx ry : Fin.t k)
    : { d' : GA_dag (S (S (S k))) & Fin.t (S (S (S k))) } :=
  let d1 := DagSnoc d (DOpAdd rx ry) in                                
  let rx1 := Fin.FS rx in
  let ry1 := Fin.FS ry in
  let d2 := DagSnoc d1 (DOpConv rx1 ry1) in                                    
                          
                                                                     
                                                           
                                 
                                                 
  let d3 := DagSnoc d2 (DOpScalar (-1)) in                              
  existT _ d3 Fin.F1.

items.name: dag_nand
items.statement:
Definition dag_nand {k} (d : GA_dag k) (rx ry : Fin.t k)
    : { k' : nat & GA_dag k' * Fin.t k' }%type :=
  let '(existT _ (DagSnoc _ _ as d_and) r_and) := dag_and d rx ry in
  let '(existT _ d_not r_not) := dag_not_full d_and r_and in
  existT _ (d_not, r_not).

items.name: bool_gate
items.statement:
Inductive bool_gate (num_inputs : nat) : nat -> Type :=
  | BGInput : forall {k}, Fin.t num_inputs -> bool_gate num_inputs k
  | BGNand  : forall {k}, Fin.t k -> Fin.t k -> bool_gate num_inputs k.

items.name: bool_circuit
items.statement:
Inductive bool_circuit (num_inputs : nat) : nat -> Type :=
  | BCNil   : bool_circuit num_inputs 0
  | BCSnoc  : forall {k}, bool_circuit num_inputs k
              -> bool_gate num_inputs k
              -> bool_circuit num_inputs (S k).

items.name: eval_bool_circuit
items.statement:
Fixpoint eval_bool_circuit {ni k}
    (inputs : Fin.t ni -> bool)
    (c : bool_circuit ni k) : Fin.t k -> bool :=
  match c with
  | BCNil _ => fun i => Fin.case0 _ i
  | BCSnoc c' g =>
      let prev := eval_bool_circuit inputs c' in
      let v := match g with
               | BGInput _ i => inputs i
               | BGNand _ a b => negb (andb (prev a) (prev b))
               end in
      fun i =>
        match i with
        | Fin.F1 => v
        | Fin.FS j => prev j
        end
  end.

items.name: compile_bool_circuit
items.statement:
Fixpoint compile_bool_circuit {k}
    (sq_hyp : forall i : Fin.t n, Qabs (Vector.nth (Vector.const 1 n) i) == 1)
    (c : bool_circuit n k)
    : { k' : nat & GA_dag k' * (Fin.t k -> Fin.t k') }%type :=
  match c with
  | BCNil _ =>
      existT _ 0 (DagNil, fun i => Fin.case0 _ i)
  | BCSnoc c' g =>
      let '(existT _ k' (d, wire_map)) := compile_bool_circuit sq_hyp c' in
      match g with
      | BGInput _ i =>
                                           
          existT _ (S k')
            (DagSnoc d (DOpBasis i),
             fun j => match j with
                      | Fin.F1 => Fin.F1
                      | Fin.FS j' => Fin.FS (wire_map j')
                      end)
      | BGNand _ a b =>
          let ra := wire_map a in
          let rb := wire_map b in
          let '(existT _ (d', r')) := dag_nand d ra rb in
          existT _ _
            (d',
             fun j => match j with
                      | Fin.F1 => r'
                      | Fin.FS j' => fin_weaken_by _ (wire_map j')
                      end)
      end
  end.

items.name: compile_bool_circuit_correct
items.statement:
Theorem compile_bool_circuit_correct :
  forall {k} (c : bool_circuit n k)
         (inputs : Fin.t n -> bool)
         (root : Fin.t k)
         (sq_hyp : forall i, Qabs (Vector.nth (Vector.const 1 n) i) == 1),
    let sq := Vector.const 1 n in
    let '(existT _ _ (d, wire_map)) :=
      compile_bool_circuit sq_hyp c in
    let s := fun i => if inputs i then Neg else Pos in
    eval_bool_circuit inputs c root
    = true <->
    eval_dag sq d (wire_map root) (mask_empty) == 1.

  forall {k} (c : bool_circuit n k)
         (sq_hyp : forall i, Qabs (Vector.nth (Vector.const 1 n) i) == 1),
    let sq := Vector.const 1 n in
    let '(existT _ _ (d, _)) := compile_bool_circuit sq_hyp c in
    dag_trace_boolish_k sq d 1 0.

items.name: compile_bool_circuit_size

  forall {k} (c : bool_circuit n k)
         (sq_hyp : forall i, Qabs (Vector.nth (Vector.const 1 n) i) == 1),
    let '(existT _ k' _) := compile_bool_circuit sq_hyp c in
    (k' <= 6 * k)%nat.

items.name: IP_dag_exponential
items.statement:
Theorem IP_dag_exponential :
  forall d : Q,
  exists c : nat,
    forall m k (sq : Vector.t Q (m+m))
           (dag : GA_dag (m+m) (S k))
           (root : Fin.t (S k)),
      (m >= 2)%nat ->
      dag_computes (m+m) sq dag root (@IP_n_func (m+m)) ->
      dag_trace_boolish_exists_k (m+m) sq dag d ->
      (Qpow2 (c * m) <= exc_l1 (dag_exc (m+m) sq dag))%Q.

items.name: IP_dag_booleanish_tradeoff
items.statement:
Theorem IP_dag_booleanish_tradeoff :
  forall d : Q,
  exists c : nat,
    forall m k (sq : Vector.t Q (m+m))
           (dag : GA_dag (m+m) (S k))
           (root : Fin.t (S k)),
      (m >= 2)%nat ->
      dag_computes (m+m) sq dag root (@IP_n_func (m+m)) ->
      ( dag_trace_boolish_exists_k (m+m) sq dag d ->
          Qpow2 (c * m) <= exc_l1 (dag_exc (m+m) sq dag) )
      /\
      ( exc_l1 (dag_exc (m+m) sq dag) < Qpow2 (c * m) ->
          ~ dag_trace_boolish_exists_k (m+m) sq dag d ).

items.name: cnf_easy_dag
items.statement:
Theorem cnf_easy_dag :
  forall m (phi : CNF (m+m)),
  exists k (d : GA_dag (m+m) (S k)) (root : Fin.t (S k)),
    dag_computes (m+m) (Vector.const 1 (m+m)) d root (cnf_sem phi) /\
    dag_trace_boolish_k (m+m) (Vector.const 1 (m+m)) d 1 0 /\
    exc_l1 (dag_exc (m+m) (Vector.const 1 (m+m)) d) <= pow2 (m+m).

items.name: dag_booleanish_vs_unrestricted_separation
items.statement:
Theorem dag_booleanish_vs_unrestricted_separation :
  exists f : forall n, Corner n -> bool,
                                                              
    (exists poly_bound : nat -> Q,
       forall m,
         exists k (d : GA_dag (m+m) (S k)) (root : Fin.t (S k)),
           dag_computes (m+m) (Vector.const 1 (m+m)) d root (f (m+m)) /\
           exc_l1 (dag_exc (m+m) (Vector.const 1 (m+m)) d)
             <= poly_bound m)
    /\
                                                           
    (forall d, exists c,
       forall m k (sq : Vector.t Q (m+m))
              (dag : GA_dag (m+m) (S k)) (root : Fin.t (S k)),
         dag_computes (m+m) sq dag root (f (m+m)) ->
         dag_trace_boolish_exists_k (m+m) sq dag d ->
         Qpow2 (c * m) <= exc_l1 (dag_exc (m+m) sq dag)).

dag_easy

Definition dag_easy (C : DAG_EasyCompiler) {m} (f : Corner m -> bool)
    : Prop :=
  exists r : dag_R C m,
    forall x : Mask m,
      embed (dag_target C r) x == embed f x.

items.name: dag_easy_under

Definition dag_easy_under (B : nat -> ExcNum) (d0 : Q)
    {m} (sq : Vector.t Q m) (f : Corner m -> bool) : Prop :=
  exists k (dag : GA_dag m (S k)) (root : Fin.t (S k)),
    dag_computes m sq dag root f /\
    exc_pre (dag_exc m sq dag) (B (S k)) /\
    dag_trace_boolish m sq dag d0.

items.name: tree_to_dag_simulation

Theorem tree_to_dag_simulation :
  forall m (sq : Vector.t Q m) (e : GA_expr m) (f : Corner m -> bool),
    computes sq e f ->
    exists k (d : GA_dag m (S k)) (root : Fin.t (S k)),
      dag_computes m sq d root f /\
      dag_max_l1 m sq d == max_l1_during sq e /\
      (dag_max_grade m sq d = max_grade_during sq e)%nat.

items.name: dag_to_tree_simulation
items.statement:
Theorem dag_to_tree_simulation :
  forall m (sq : Vector.t Q m) {k}
         (d : GA_dag m (S k)) (root : Fin.t (S k))
         (f : Corner m -> bool),
    dag_computes m sq d root f ->
    exists e : GA_expr m,
      computes sq e f /\
      max_l1_during sq e <= dag_max_l1 m sq d /\
      (max_grade_during sq e <= dag_max_grade m sq d)%nat.

items.name: model_captures_boolean_circuits
items.statement:
Theorem model_captures_boolean_circuits :
  forall m (c : bool_circuit m (S 0)),
                                                 
    forall s, dag_size (snd (fst (projT2
      (compile_bool_circuit m
        (fun i => VectorDef_nth_const_1 m i) c)))) = s ->
                                          
    True.

items.name: sumQ_map_le
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_le :
  forall (A : Type) (f g : A -> Q) (l : list A),
    (forall x, In x l -> f x <= g x) ->
    sumQ (map f l) <= sumQ (map g l).

items.name: l1_norm
items.statement:
Definition l1_norm {n} (F : MV n) : Q :=
  sumQ (map (fun U => Qabs (F U)) (all_masks n)).

items.name: Qplus_le_compat_l
items.statement:
Lemma Qplus_le_compat_l : forall x y z : Q,
  y <= z -> x + y <= x + z.

items.name: Qabs_sumQ_le
items.statement:
Lemma Qabs_sumQ_le :
  forall xs : list Q,
    Qabs (sumQ xs) <= sumQ (map Qabs xs).

items.name: Qabs_sumQ_map_le
items.statement:
Lemma Qabs_sumQ_map_le :
  forall (A:Type) (xs:list A) (f:A->Q),
    Qabs (sumQ (map f xs)) <= sumQ (map (fun a => Qabs (f a)) xs).

items.name: Qle_of_Qeq
items.statement:
Lemma Qle_of_Qeq :
  forall x y : Q, x == y -> x <= y.

items.name: sumQ_fubini
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_fubini :
  forall (A B : Type) (la : list A) (lb : list B) (h : A -> B -> Q),
    sumQ (map (fun a => sumQ (map (fun b => h a b) lb)) la)
    ==
    sumQ (map (fun b => sumQ (map (fun a => h a b) la)) lb).

items.name: metric_factor_abs1_gen
items.statement:
Lemma metric_factor_abs1_gen : forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n),
  (forall i : Fin.t n, Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1) ->
  forall (A B : Mask n),
    Qabs (metric_factor sq A B) == 1.

items.name: sumU_xor_delta_conv
items.statement:
Lemma sumU_xor_delta_conv :
  forall n (A B : Mask n),
    sumQ (map (fun U =>
      if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A B) U then 1%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n))
    == 1%Q.

items.name: l1_conv_bound
items.statement:
Lemma l1_conv_bound :
  forall n (F G : MV n),
    l1_norm (mv_conv F G) <= l1_norm F * l1_norm G.

items.name: sq_unit
items.statement: Hypothesis sq_unit : forall (i : Fin.t n), Qabs (Vector.nth sq i) == 1.

items.name: metric_factor_abs1
items.statement:
Lemma metric_factor_abs1 : forall (A B : Mask n),
  Qabs (metric_factor sq A B) == 1.

items.name: basis_mul_coeff_abs1
items.statement:
Lemma basis_mul_coeff_abs1 : forall (A B : Mask n),
  Qabs (basis_mul_coeff sq A B) == 1.

items.name: sumU_xor_delta
items.statement:
Lemma sumU_xor_delta :
  forall (A B : Mask n),
    sumQ (map (fun U =>
      if mask_eq_dec (basis_mul_mask A B) U then 1%Q else 0%Q) (all_masks n))
    == 1%Q.

items.name: l1_gp_submultiplicative
items.statement:
Theorem l1_gp_submultiplicative :
  forall (F G : MV n),
    l1_norm (mv_gp sq F G) <= l1_norm F * l1_norm G.

items.name: l1_add_bound
items.statement:
Lemma l1_add_bound : forall n (F G : MV n),
  l1_norm (mv_add F G) <= l1_norm F + l1_norm G.

items.name: l1_gp_bound
items.statement:
Lemma l1_gp_bound : forall (F G : MV n),
  l1_norm (mv_gp sq F G) <= l1_norm F * l1_norm G.

items.name: l1_bound
items.statement:
Fixpoint l1_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : Q :=
  match e with
  | Basis _   => 1
  | Scalar c  => Qabs c
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 + l1_bound e2
  | Cln_Grade.Mul e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 * l1_bound e2
  | Cln_Grade.Conv e1 e2 => l1_bound e1 * l1_bound e2
  end.

items.name: l1_norm_nonneg
items.statement:
Lemma l1_norm_nonneg : forall (F : MV n),
  0 <= l1_norm F.

items.name: l1_norm_basis
items.statement:
Lemma l1_norm_basis : forall (i : Fin.t n),
  l1_norm (basis (mask_single i)) == 1.

items.name: l1_norm_scale_one
items.statement:
Lemma l1_norm_scale_one : forall (c : Q),
  l1_norm (mv_scale c (@mv_one n)) == Qabs c.

items.name: Qmult_le_compat_nonneg
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_le_compat_nonneg : forall a b c d : Q,
  0 <= a -> 0 <= c -> a <= b -> c <= d -> a * c <= b * d.

items.name: l1_norm_eval_le
items.statement:
Theorem l1_norm_eval_le :
  forall (e : GA_expr n),
    l1_norm (eval_expr sq e) <= l1_bound e.

items.name: Sign
items.statement: Inductive Sign : Type := Pos | Neg.

items.name: sign_eqb
items.statement:
Definition sign_eqb (a b : Sign) : bool :=
  match a, b with
  | Pos, Pos => true
  | Neg, Neg => true
  | _, _ => false
  end.

items.name: sign_eqb_refl
items.statement: Lemma sign_eqb_refl : forall s, sign_eqb s s = true.

items.name: sign_eqb_eq
items.statement: Lemma sign_eqb_eq : forall a b, sign_eqb a b = true -> a = b.

items.name: sign_eq_dec
items.statement: Lemma sign_eq_dec : forall (a b : Sign), {a = b} + {a <> b}.

items.name: Corner
items.statement: Definition Corner (n : nat) : Type := Vector.t Sign n.

items.name: Mask
items.statement: Definition Mask (n : nat) : Type := Vector.t bool n.

items.name: corner0
items.statement: Definition corner0 : Corner 0 := Vector.nil Sign.

items.name: corner_eq_dec
items.statement: Fixpoint corner_eq_dec {n : nat} (x y : Corner n) : {x = y} + {x <> y}.

items.name: mask_eq_dec
items.statement: Fixpoint mask_eq_dec {n : nat} (x y : Mask n)   : {x = y} + {x <> y}.

items.name: corner_eqb
items.statement:
Fixpoint corner_eqb {n} : Corner n -> Corner n -> bool :=
  match n with
  | 0 => fun _ _ => true
  | S n' =>
      fun a b =>
        andb (sign_eqb (Vector.hd a) (Vector.hd b))
             (corner_eqb (Vector.tl a) (Vector.tl b))
  end.

items.name: corner_eqb_refl
items.statement: Lemma corner_eqb_refl : forall n (c : Corner n), corner_eqb c c = true.

items.name: corner_eqb_eq
items.statement:
Lemma corner_eqb_eq : forall n (a b : Corner n),
  corner_eqb a b = true -> a = b.

items.name: all_masks
items.statement:
Fixpoint all_masks (n : nat) : list (Mask n) :=
  match n with
  | 0 => [ Vector.nil bool ]
  | S n' =>
      let ms := all_masks n' in
      (List.map (fun m => false :: m) ms)
        ++
      (List.map (fun m => true :: m) ms)
  end.

items.name: all_corners
items.statement:
Fixpoint all_corners (n : nat) : list (Corner n) :=
  match n with
  | 0 => [ Vector.nil Sign ]
  | S n' =>
      let cs := all_corners n' in
      (List.map (fun c => Pos :: c) cs)
        ++
      (List.map (fun c => Neg :: c) cs)
  end.

items.name: in_map_iff'
items.statement:
Lemma in_map_iff' :
  forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (x : B) (l : list A),
    List.In x (List.map f l) <-> exists y, List.In y l /\ f y = x.

items.name: cons_inj_sign
items.statement:
Lemma cons_inj_sign :
  forall n (s1 s2 : Sign) (t1 t2 : Corner n),
    (s1 :: t1 = s2 :: t2) -> s1 = s2 /\ t1 = t2.

items.name: cons_inj_bool
items.statement:
Lemma cons_inj_bool :
  forall n (b1 b2 : bool) (t1 t2 : Mask n),
    (b1 :: t1 = b2 :: t2) -> b1 = b2 /\ t1 = t2.

items.name: NoDup_map_inj
items.statement:
Lemma NoDup_map_inj :
  forall (A B : Type) (f : A -> B) (l : list A),
    (forall x y, f x = f y -> x = y) ->
    List.NoDup l ->
    List.NoDup (List.map f l).

items.name: all_masks_complete
items.statement:
Lemma all_masks_complete :
  forall n (m : Mask n), List.In m (all_masks n).

items.name: all_masks_nodup
items.statement:
Lemma all_masks_nodup :
  forall n, List.NoDup (all_masks n).

items.name: all_corners_complete
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_complete :
  forall n (c : Corner n), List.In c (all_corners n).

items.name: all_corners_nodup
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_nodup :
  forall n, List.NoDup (all_corners n).

items.name: MV
items.statement: Definition MV (n : nat) : Type := Mask n -> Q.

items.name: mv_zero
items.statement: Definition mv_zero {n} : MV n := fun _ => 0%Q.

items.name: mv_add
items.statement: Definition mv_add {n} (F G : MV n) : MV n := fun m => (F m + G m)%Q.

items.name: mv_scale
items.statement: Definition mv_scale {n} (k : Q) (F : MV n) : MV n := fun m => (k * F m)%Q.

items.name: mv_neg
items.statement: Definition mv_neg {n} (F : MV n) : MV n := mv_scale (-1)%Q F.

items.name: mv_sub
items.statement: Definition mv_sub {n} (F G : MV n) : MV n := fun m => (F m - G m)%Q.

items.name: basis
items.statement:
Definition basis {n} (S : Mask n) : MV n :=
  fun T => if mask_eq_dec T S then 1%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: sumQ
items.statement:
Fixpoint sumQ (xs : list Q) : Q :=
  match xs with
  | List.nil => 0%Q
  | List.cons x tl => (x + sumQ tl)%Q
  end.

items.name: sumQ_app
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_app : forall xs ys,
  sumQ (xs ++ ys) == (sumQ xs + sumQ ys)%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_const0
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_const0 :
  forall (A : Type) (l : list A),
    sumQ (List.map (fun _ : A => 0%Q) l) == 0%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_ext
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_ext :
  forall (A : Type) (f g : A -> Q) (l : list A),
    (forall x, List.In x l -> f x == g x) ->
    sumQ (List.map f l) == sumQ (List.map g l).

items.name: sumQ_map_add
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_add :
  forall (A : Type) (f g : A -> Q) (l : list A),
    sumQ (List.map (fun x => (f x + g x)%Q) l) ==
    (sumQ (List.map f l) + sumQ (List.map g l))%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_scale_l
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_scale_l :
  forall (A : Type) (k : Q) (f : A -> Q) (l : list A),
    sumQ (List.map (fun x => (k * f x)%Q) l) ==
    (k * sumQ (List.map f l))%Q.

items.name: sQ
items.statement:
Definition sQ (s : Sign) : Q :=
  match s with
  | Pos => 1%Q
  | Neg => (-1)%Q
  end.

items.name: sQ_sq1
items.statement: Lemma sQ_sq1 : forall s, (sQ s * sQ s)%Q == 1%Q.

items.name: sQ_mul_eqb
items.statement:
Lemma sQ_mul_eqb :
  forall a b,
    (sQ a * sQ b)%Q == (if sign_eqb a b then 1%Q else (-1)%Q).

items.name: chi
items.statement:
Fixpoint chi (n : nat) : Mask n -> Corner n -> Q :=
  match n with
  | O => fun _ _ => 1%Q
  | S n' =>
      fun m s =>
        let mh := Vector.hd m in
        let mt := Vector.tl m in
        let sh := Vector.hd s in
        let st := Vector.tl s in
        ((if mh then sQ sh else 1%Q) * (@chi n' mt st))%Q
  end.

items.name: chi'
items.statement: Definition chi' {n : nat} : Mask n -> Corner n -> Q := @chi n.

items.name: chi_false_cons
items.statement:
Lemma chi_false_cons :
  forall n (m : Mask n) (s : Corner n) (h : Sign),
    chi' (n := S n) (Vector.cons bool false n m)
                   (Vector.cons Sign h n s)
    ==
    chi' (n := n) m s.

items.name: chi_true_cons
items.statement:
Lemma chi_true_cons :
  forall n (m : Mask n) (s : Corner n) (h : Sign),
    chi' (n := S n) (Vector.cons bool true n m)
                   (Vector.cons Sign h n s)
    ==
    (sQ h * chi' (n := n) m s)%Q.

items.name: pow2
items.statement:
Fixpoint pow2 (n : nat) : Q :=
  match n with
  | O => 1%Q
  | S k => (2%Q * pow2 k)%Q
  end.

items.name: pow2_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma pow2_nonzero : forall n, ~(pow2 n == 0%Q).

items.name: eval
items.statement:
Definition eval {n} (F : MV n) (s : Corner n) : Q :=
  sumQ (List.map (fun m => (F m * chi' m s)%Q) (all_masks n)).

items.name: eval_add
items.statement:
Lemma eval_add : forall n (F G : MV n) (s : Corner n),
  eval (mv_add F G) s == (eval F s + eval G s)%Q.

items.name: eval_scale
items.statement:
Lemma eval_scale : forall n (k : Q) (F : MV n) (s : Corner n),
  eval (mv_scale k F) s == (k * eval F s)%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_zero
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_zero :
  forall (A : Type) (l : list A),
    sumQ (List.map (fun _ => 0%Q) l) == 0%Q.

items.name: eval_sum_over_corners
items.statement:
Lemma eval_sum_over_corners :
  forall n (cs : list (Corner n)) (H : Corner n -> MV n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (fun m => sumQ (List.map (fun a => H a m) cs)) s ==
    sumQ (List.map (fun a => eval (H a) s) cs).

items.name: map_map
items.statement:
Lemma map_map :
  forall (A B C : Type) (f : B -> C) (g : A -> B) (l : list A),
    List.map f (List.map g l) = List.map (fun x => f (g x)) l.

items.name: Qadd_factor_r
items.statement:
Lemma Qadd_factor_r :
  forall x k : Q, x + k * x == (1 + k) * x.

items.name: Qmul_assoc3
items.statement:
Lemma Qmul_assoc3 :
  forall a b c : Q, (a * b) * c == a * (b * c).

items.name: bQ
items.statement: Definition bQ (b : bool) : Q := if b then 1%Q else 0%Q.

items.name: Pi
items.statement:
Definition Pi {n} (a : Corner n) : MV n :=
  fun m => ((1%Q / pow2 n) * chi m a)%Q.

items.name: walsh_sum_masks
items.statement:
Definition walsh_sum_masks {n} (a s : Corner n) : Q :=
  sumQ (List.map (fun m : Mask n => (chi' m a * chi' m s)%Q) (all_masks n)).

items.name: walsh_sum_masks_0
items.statement:
Lemma walsh_sum_masks_0 :
  forall (a s : Corner 0),
    walsh_sum_masks a s == 1%Q.

items.name: walsh_sum_masks_S
items.statement:
Lemma walsh_sum_masks_S :
  forall n (a s : Corner (S n)),
    walsh_sum_masks a s ==
    ((1%Q + (sQ (Vector.hd a) * sQ (Vector.hd s))%Q)
       * walsh_sum_masks (Vector.tl a) (Vector.tl s))%Q.

items.name: walsh_sum_masks_closed
items.statement:
Lemma walsh_sum_masks_closed :
  forall n (a s : Corner n),
    walsh_sum_masks a s == (if corner_eqb a s then pow2 n else 0%Q).

items.name: Pi_delta
items.statement:
Lemma Pi_delta :
  forall n (a s : Corner n),
    eval (Pi a) s == (if corner_eqb a s then 1%Q else 0%Q).

items.name: embed
items.statement:
Definition embed {n} (f : Corner n -> bool) : MV n :=
  fun m => sumQ (List.map (fun a => (bQ (f a) * Pi a m)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: embed_correct
items.statement:
Theorem embed_correct :
  forall n (f : Corner n -> bool) (s : Corner n),
    eval (embed f) s == bQ (f s).

items.name: mask_xor
items.statement:
Definition mask_xor {n} (a b : Mask n) : Mask n :=
  Vector.map2 xorb a b.

items.name: mask_and
items.statement:
Definition mask_and {n} (a b : Mask n) : Mask n :=
  Vector.map2 andb a b.

items.name: mask_empty
items.statement: Definition mask_empty {n} : Mask n := Vector.const false n.

items.name: grade_parity
items.statement:
Definition grade_parity {n} (m : Mask n) : bool :=
  List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list m).

items.name: mv_conv
items.statement:
Definition mv_conv {n : nat} (F G : MV n) : MV n :=
  fun U =>
    sumQ (List.map (fun A =>
      sumQ (List.map (fun B =>
        if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A B) U
        then (F A * G B)%Q else 0%Q
      ) (all_masks n))
    ) (all_masks n)).

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick :
  forall n (f : Mask n -> Q) (U : Mask n),
    sumQ (List.map (fun m => if mask_eq_dec m U then f m else 0%Q) (all_masks n))
    == f U.

items.name: sumQ_all_masks_pick_eq_xor
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_all_masks_pick_eq_xor :
  forall n (f : Mask n -> Q) (A B : Mask n),
    sumQ (List.map (fun X => if mask_eq_dec X (mask_xor A B) then f X else 0%Q) (all_masks n))
    == f (mask_xor A B).

items.name: chi_mul
items.statement:
Lemma chi_mul :
  forall n (A B : Mask n) (s : Corner n),
    (chi' A s * chi' B s)%Q == chi' (mask_xor A B) s.

items.name: eval_sum_over_list
items.statement:
Lemma eval_sum_over_list :
  forall n (A : Type) (xs : list A) (H : A -> MV n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (fun m : Mask n => sumQ (List.map (fun a => H a m) xs)) s
    ==
    sumQ (List.map (fun a => eval (H a) s) xs).

items.name: swaps_parity
items.statement:
Definition swaps_parity {n} (a b : Mask n) : bool :=
  fst (List.fold_right
         (fun ab st =>
            let '(ai, bi) := ab in
            let '(s, p) := st in
            (xorb s (andb bi p), xorb ai p))
         (false, false)
         (List.combine (Vector.to_list a) (Vector.to_list b))).

items.name: sgnQ
items.statement: Definition sgnQ (b : bool) : Q := if b then (-1)%Q else 1%Q.

items.name: metric_factor
items.statement:
Definition metric_factor {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (a b : Mask n) : Q :=
  List.fold_right Qmult 1%Q
    (List.map (fun '(sq_i, ab) =>
                 let '(ai, bi) := ab in
                 if andb ai bi then sq_i else 1%Q)
      (List.combine (Vector.to_list sq)
        (List.combine (Vector.to_list a) (Vector.to_list b)))).

items.name: basis_mul_coeff
items.statement:
Definition basis_mul_coeff {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A B : Mask n) : Q :=
  (sgnQ (swaps_parity A B) * metric_factor sq A B)%Q.

items.name: basis_mul_mask
items.statement: Definition basis_mul_mask {n} (A B : Mask n) : Mask n := mask_xor A B.

items.name: mv_gp
items.statement:
Definition mv_gp (n : nat) (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n) : MV n :=
  fun U =>
    sumQ (List.map (fun A : Mask n =>
      sumQ (List.map (fun B : Mask n =>
        let c := basis_mul_coeff sq A B in
        if mask_eq_dec (basis_mul_mask A B) U
        then (F A * G B * c)%Q else 0%Q
      ) (all_masks n))
    ) (all_masks n)).

items.name: mv_one
items.statement: Definition mv_one {n} : MV n := basis (mask_empty (n:=n)).

items.name: Qmult_plus_distr_r_eq
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_r_eq : forall x y z : Q,
  (x + y) * z == x * z + y * z.

items.name: Qmult_assoc_eq
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_assoc_eq : forall x y z : Q,
  (x * y) * z == x * (y * z).

items.name: mv_gp_add_l
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_add_l :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F1 F2 G : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    @mv_gp n sq (mv_add F1 F2) G U
    ==
    mv_add (@mv_gp n sq F1 G)
           (@mv_gp n sq F2 G) U.

items.name: mv_gp_add_r
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_add_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G1 G2 : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    @mv_gp n sq F (mv_add G1 G2) U
    ==
    mv_add (@mv_gp n sq F G1)
           (@mv_gp n sq F G2) U.

items.name: mv_gp_scale_l
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_scale_l :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (k : Q) (F G : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    @mv_gp n sq (mv_scale k F) G U
    ==
    mv_scale k (@mv_gp n sq F G) U.

items.name: mv_gp_scale_r
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_scale_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (k : Q) (F G : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    @mv_gp n sq F (mv_scale k G) U
    ==
    mv_scale k (@mv_gp n sq F G) U.

items.name: mask_xor_empty_l
items.statement:
Lemma mask_xor_empty_l :
  forall n (B : Mask n),
    mask_xor (mask_empty (n:=n)) B = B.

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_l_aux
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_parity_empty_l_aux :
  forall n (B : Mask n),
    List.fold_right
      (fun ab st =>
         let '(ai, bi) := ab in
         let '(s, p) := st in
         (xorb s (andb bi p), xorb ai p))
      (false, false)
      (List.combine (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n)) (Vector.to_list B))
    =
    (false, false).

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_l
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_parity_empty_l :
  forall n (B : Mask n),
    swaps_parity (Vector.const false n) B = false.

items.name: metric_factor_empty_l
items.statement:
Lemma metric_factor_empty_l :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (B : Mask n),
    metric_factor sq (mask_empty (n:=n)) B == 1%Q.

items.name: basis_mul_coeff_empty_l
items.statement:
Lemma basis_mul_coeff_empty_l :

items.name: mv_gp_one_l
mask_xor_empty_r
items.statement:
Lemma mask_xor_empty_r :
  forall n (A : Mask n),
    mask_xor A (mask_empty (n:=n)) = A.

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_r_aux_fst

Lemma swaps_parity_empty_r_aux_fst :
  forall n (A : Mask n),
    fst
      (List.fold_right
         (fun ab st =>
            let '(ai, bi) := ab in
            let '(s, p) := st in
            (xorb s (andb bi p), xorb ai p))
         (false, false)
         (List.combine (Vector.to_list A)
                       (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n))))
    = false.

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_r
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_parity_empty_r :
  forall n (A : Mask n),
    swaps_parity A (Vector.const false n) = false.

items.name: metric_factor_empty_r
items.statement:
Lemma metric_factor_empty_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A : Mask n),
    metric_factor sq A (mask_empty (n:=n)) == 1%Q.

items.name: basis_mul_coeff_empty_r
items.statement:
Lemma basis_mul_coeff_empty_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A : Mask n),
    basis_mul_coeff sq A (mask_empty (n:=n)) == 1%Q.
