mv_gp_basis
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_basis :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A B : Mask n) (U : Mask n),
    @mv_gp n sq (basis A) (basis B) U
    ==
    (if mask_eq_dec U (basis_mul_mask A B)
     then basis_mul_coeff sq A B
     else 0%Q).

items.name: mask_single
items.statement:
Fixpoint mask_single {n : nat} (i : Fin.t n) : Mask n :=
  match i with
  | Fin.F1 =>
      true :: Vector.const false _
  | Fin.FS j =>
      false :: mask_single j
  end.

items.name: e
items.statement: Definition e (n : nat) (i : Fin.t n) : MV n := basis (mask_single i).

items.name: mask_xor_self
items.statement:
Lemma mask_xor_self :
  forall n (A : Mask n),
    mask_xor A A = mask_empty (n:=n).

items.name: mask_xor_comm
items.statement:
Lemma mask_xor_comm :
  forall n (A B : Mask n),
    mask_xor A B = mask_xor B A.

items.name: metric_factor_single_square
items.statement:
Lemma metric_factor_single_square :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i : Fin.t n),
    metric_factor sq (mask_single i) (mask_single i) == Vector.nth sq i.

items.name: swaps_parity_const_false
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_parity_const_false :
  forall n,
    swaps_parity (Vector.const false n) (Vector.const false n) = false.

items.name: swaps_state_const_false
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_state_const_false :
  forall n,
    List.fold_right
      (fun ab st : bool * bool =>
         let '(ai, bi) := ab in
         let '(s, p) := st in (xorb s (bi && p), xorb ai p))
      (false, false)
      (List.combine (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n))
                    (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n)))
    = (false, false).

items.name: swaps_parity_single_self
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_parity_single_self :
  forall n (i : Fin.t n),
    swaps_parity (mask_single i) (mask_single i) = false.

items.name: e_square
items.statement:
Lemma e_square :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i : Fin.t n) (U : Mask n),
    (@mv_gp n sq (e i) (e i)) U
    ==
    (mv_scale (Vector.nth sq i) mv_one) U.

items.name: metric_factor_single_disjoint
items.statement:
Lemma metric_factor_single_disjoint :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i j : Fin.t n),
    i <> j ->
    metric_factor sq (mask_single i) (mask_single j) == 1%Q.

items.name: swaps_parity_empty_r_aux_snd
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_parity_empty_r_aux_snd :
  forall n (A : Mask n),
    snd
      (List.fold_right
         (fun ab st =>
            let '(ai, bi) := ab in
            let '(s, p) := st in
            (xorb s (andb bi p), xorb ai p))
         (false, false)
         (List.combine (Vector.to_list A)
                       (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n))))
    = List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list A).

items.name: parity_const_false
items.statement:
Lemma parity_const_false :
  forall n,
    List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list (Vector.const false n)) = false.

items.name: to_list_cons
items.statement:
Lemma to_list_cons :
  forall (A : Type) n (a : A) (v : Vector.t A n),
    Vector.to_list (Vector.cons A a n v) = (a :: Vector.to_list v)%list.

items.name: mask_single_FS
items.statement:
Lemma mask_single_FS :
  forall n (j : Fin.t n),
    mask_single (Fin.FS j) = Vector.cons bool false n (mask_single j).

items.name: parity_mask_single_true
items.statement:
Lemma parity_mask_single_true :
  forall n (j : Fin.t n),
    List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list (mask_single j)) = true.

items.name: fst_let_pair
items.statement:
Lemma fst_let_pair :
  forall (t : bool * bool),
    fst (let '(s,p) := t in (xorb s false, p)) = fst t.

items.name: swaps_parity_single_swap_negb
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_parity_single_swap_negb :
  forall n (i j : Fin.t n),
    i <> j ->
    swaps_parity (mask_single i) (mask_single j)
    =
    negb (swaps_parity (mask_single j) (mask_single i)).

items.name: sgnQ_swaps_parity_flip
items.statement:
Lemma sgnQ_swaps_parity_flip :
  forall n (i j : Fin.t n),
    i <> j ->
    sgnQ (swaps_parity (mask_single i) (mask_single j))
    ==
    (-1)%Q * sgnQ (swaps_parity (mask_single j) (mask_single i)).

items.name: e_anticomm
items.statement:
Lemma e_anticomm :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (i j : Fin.t n) (U : Mask n),
    i <> j ->
    (@mv_gp n sq (e i) (e j)) U
    ==
    mv_scale (-1)%Q (@mv_gp n sq (e j) (e i)) U.

items.name: sgnQ_xorb
items.statement:
Lemma sgnQ_xorb :
  forall b1 b2,
    (sgnQ b1 * sgnQ b2)%Q == sgnQ (xorb b1 b2).

items.name: sgnQ_negb
items.statement:
Lemma sgnQ_negb :
  forall b, sgnQ (negb b) == (-1)%Q * sgnQ b.

items.name: sumQ_fubini
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_fubini :
  forall (A B : Type) (la : list A) (lb : list B) (h : A -> B -> Q),
    sumQ (List.map (fun a => sumQ (List.map (fun b => h a b) lb)) la)
    ==
    sumQ (List.map (fun b => sumQ (List.map (fun a => h a b) la)) lb).

items.name: parity_mask
items.statement:
Definition parity_mask {n} (A : Mask n) : bool :=
  List.fold_right xorb false (Vector.to_list A).

items.name: parity_mask_cons
items.statement:
Lemma parity_mask_cons :
  forall n (h:bool) (A:Mask n),
    parity_mask (h :: A) = xorb h (parity_mask A).

items.name: map2_cons
items.statement:
Lemma map2_cons :
  forall (A B C : Type) (g : A -> B -> C) n
         (a : A) (b : B) (va : Vector.t A n) (vb : Vector.t B n),
    Vector.map2 g (a :: va) (b :: vb) = (g a b) :: Vector.map2 g va vb.

items.name: mask_xor_cons
items.statement:
Lemma mask_xor_cons :
  forall n (a b : bool) (A B : Mask n),
    mask_xor (a :: A) (b :: B) = (xorb a b) :: mask_xor A B.

items.name: xorb_assoc
items.statement: Lemma xorb_assoc : forall a b c, xorb a (xorb b c) = xorb (xorb a b) c.

items.name: xorb_comm
items.statement: Lemma xorb_comm : forall a b, xorb a b = xorb b a.

items.name: parity_mask_xor
items.statement:
Lemma parity_mask_xor :
  forall n (A B : Mask n),
    parity_mask (mask_xor A B) = xorb (parity_mask A) (parity_mask B).

items.name: swaps_state_snd
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_state_snd :
  forall n (A B : Mask n),
    snd
      (List.fold_right
         (fun ab st : bool * bool =>
            let '(ai, bi) := ab in
            let '(s, p) := st in (xorb s (bi && p), xorb ai p))
         (false, false)
         (List.combine (Vector.to_list A) (Vector.to_list B)))
    = parity_mask A.

items.name: swaps_parity_cons
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_parity_cons :
  forall n (a b : bool) (A B : Mask n),
    swaps_parity (Vector.cons _ a _ A) (Vector.cons _ b _ B)
    =
    xorb (swaps_parity A B) (b && parity_mask A).

items.name: swaps_parity_cocycle
items.statement:
Lemma swaps_parity_cocycle :
  forall n (A B C : Mask n),
    xorb (swaps_parity A B) (swaps_parity (mask_xor A B) C)
    =
    xorb (swaps_parity B C) (swaps_parity A (mask_xor B C)).

items.name: metric_factor_cons
items.statement:
Lemma metric_factor_cons :
  forall n (h : Q) (sq : Vector.t Q n) (a b : bool) (A B : Mask n),
    metric_factor (Vector.cons Q h n sq)
                  (Vector.cons bool a n A)
                  (Vector.cons bool b n B)
    ==
    (if andb a b then h else 1%Q) * metric_factor sq A B.

items.name: metric_factor_cocycle
items.statement:
Lemma metric_factor_cocycle :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (A B C : Mask n),
    (metric_factor sq A B * metric_factor sq (mask_xor A B) C)%Q
    ==
    (metric_factor sq B C * metric_factor sq A (mask_xor B C))%Q.

items.name: basis_mul_assoc_coeff
items.statement:
Lemma basis_mul_assoc_coeff :
  forall n sq (A B C : Mask n),
    (basis_mul_coeff sq A B * basis_mul_coeff sq (basis_mul_mask A B) C)%Q
    ==
    (basis_mul_coeff sq B C * basis_mul_coeff sq A (basis_mul_mask B C))%Q.

items.name: mask0_eta
items.statement: Lemma mask0_eta : forall (C : Mask 0), C = [].

items.name: mask_xor_assoc
items.statement:
Lemma mask_xor_assoc :
  forall n (A B C : Mask n),
    mask_xor (mask_xor A B) C = mask_xor A (mask_xor B C).

items.name: mask_xor_cancel_l
items.statement:
Lemma mask_xor_cancel_l :
  forall n (X Y : Mask n),
    mask_xor X Y = X -> Y = mask_empty (n:=n).

items.name: if_mask_eq_dec_sym
items.statement:
Lemma if_mask_eq_dec_sym :
  forall n (X Y : Mask n) (a b : Q),
    (if mask_eq_dec X Y then a else b)
    ==
    (if mask_eq_dec Y X then a else b).

items.name: mv_gp_triple
items.statement:
Definition mv_gp_triple (n : nat) (sq : Vector.t Q n)
  (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n) : Q :=
  sumQ (List.map (fun A =>
  sumQ (List.map (fun B =>
  sumQ (List.map (fun C =>
    if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor (mask_xor A B) C) U
    then (F A * G B * H C
          * basis_mul_coeff sq A B
          * basis_mul_coeff sq (mask_xor A B) C)%Q
    else 0%Q) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: sumQ_map_scale_r
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_scale_r :
  forall (A : Type) (k : Q) (f : A -> Q) (xs : list A),
    sumQ (List.map (fun x => (f x * k)%Q) xs)
    ==
    (sumQ (List.map f xs) * k)%Q.

items.name: sumQ_map_push_const
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_push_const :
  forall (A : Type) (xs : list A) (k : Q) (f : A -> Q),
    sumQ (List.map (fun x => (k * f x)%Q) xs)
    ==
    (k * sumQ (List.map f xs))%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_LHS_quad
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_assoc_LHS_quad :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    mv_gp sq (mv_gp sq F G) H U
    ==
    sumQ (List.map (fun X : Mask n =>
      sumQ (List.map (fun C : Mask n =>
        if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor X C) U
        then
          (sumQ (List.map (fun A : Mask n =>
             sumQ (List.map (fun B : Mask n =>
               if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A B) X
               then (F A * G B * basis_mul_coeff sq A B)%Q
               else 0%Q) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))
           * H C * basis_mul_coeff sq X C)%Q
        else 0%Q
      ) (all_masks n))
    ) (all_masks n)).

items.name: K_LHS
items.statement:
Definition K_LHS {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n)
  (X C A B : Mask n) : Q :=
  if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor X C) U then
    if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A B) X then
      (F A * G B * H C
       * basis_mul_coeff sq A B
       * basis_mul_coeff sq X C)%Q
    else 0%Q
  else 0%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_LHS_quad_kernel
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_assoc_LHS_quad_kernel :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    mv_gp sq (mv_gp sq F G) H U
    ==
    sumQ (List.map (fun X : Mask n =>
      sumQ (List.map (fun C : Mask n =>
        sumQ (List.map (fun A : Mask n =>
          sumQ (List.map (fun B : Mask n =>
            K_LHS sq F G H U X C A B) (all_masks n)))
        (all_masks n)))
      (all_masks n)))
    (all_masks n)).

items.name: if_mask_eq_dec_flip
items.statement:
Lemma if_mask_eq_dec_flip :
  forall n (X Y : Mask n) (t e : Q),
    (if mask_eq_dec X Y then t else e)
    ==
    (if mask_eq_dec Y X then t else e).

items.name: sumQ_fubini_masks
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_fubini_masks (n : nat) (h : Mask n -> Mask n -> Q) :
  sumQ (List.map (fun x => sumQ (List.map (h x) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))
  ==
  sumQ (List.map (fun y => sumQ (List.map (fun x => h x y) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: sumQ_fubini_masks_in
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_fubini_masks_in (n : nat) (L : list (Mask n)) (h : Mask n -> Mask n -> Mask n -> Q) :
  sumQ (List.map (fun x =>
    sumQ (List.map (fun a =>
      sumQ (List.map (fun b => h x a b) (all_masks n)))
    (all_masks n))) L)
  ==
  sumQ (List.map (fun x =>
    sumQ (List.map (fun b =>
      sumQ (List.map (fun a => h x a b) (all_masks n)))
    (all_masks n))) L).

items.name: K_LHS_X_collapse
items.statement:
Lemma K_LHS_X_collapse :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U C A B : Mask n),
    sumQ (List.map (fun X => K_LHS sq F G H U X C A B) (all_masks n))
    ==
    if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor (mask_xor A B) C) U
    then (F A * G B * H C
          * basis_mul_coeff sq A B
          * basis_mul_coeff sq (mask_xor A B) C)%Q
    else 0%Q.

items.name: K_RHS
items.statement:
Definition K_RHS {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n)
  (A Y B C : Mask n) : Q :=
  if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A Y) U then
    if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor B C) Y then
      (F A * G B * H C
       * basis_mul_coeff sq B C
       * basis_mul_coeff sq A Y)%Q
    else 0%Q
  else 0%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_RHS_quad_kernel
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_assoc_RHS_quad_kernel :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    mv_gp sq F (mv_gp sq G H) U
    ==
    sumQ (List.map (fun A : Mask n =>
      sumQ (List.map (fun Y : Mask n =>
        sumQ (List.map (fun B : Mask n =>
          sumQ (List.map (fun C : Mask n =>
            K_RHS sq F G H U A Y B C) (all_masks n)))
        (all_masks n)))
      (all_masks n)))
    (all_masks n)).

items.name: K_RHS_Y_collapse
items.statement:
Lemma K_RHS_Y_collapse :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U A B C : Mask n),
    sumQ (List.map (fun Y => K_RHS sq F G H U A Y B C) (all_masks n))
    ==
    if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A (mask_xor B C)) U
    then (F A * G B * H C
          * basis_mul_coeff sq B C
          * basis_mul_coeff sq A (mask_xor B C))%Q
    else 0%Q.

items.name: K_LHS_B_collapse
items.statement:
Lemma K_LHS_B_collapse :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U X C A : Mask n),
    sumQ (List.map (fun B => K_LHS sq F G H U X C A B) (all_masks n))
    ==
    if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor X C) U
    then (F A * G (mask_xor A X) * H C
          * basis_mul_coeff sq A (mask_xor A X)
          * basis_mul_coeff sq X C)%Q
    else 0%Q.

items.name: K_LHS_CAB
items.statement:
Definition K_LHS_CAB {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n)
  (X C A B : Mask n) : Q :=
  if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor X B) U then
    if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor C A) X then
      (F C * G A * H B
       * basis_mul_coeff sq C A
       * basis_mul_coeff sq X B)%Q
    else 0%Q
  else 0%Q.

items.name: K_LHS_X_collapse_CAB
items.statement:
Lemma K_LHS_X_collapse_CAB :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U A B C : Mask n),
    sumQ (List.map (fun X => K_LHS sq F G H U X A B C) (all_masks n))
    ==
    if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor (mask_xor B C) A) U
    then (F B * G C * H A
          * basis_mul_coeff sq B C
          * basis_mul_coeff sq (mask_xor B C) A)%Q
    else 0%Q.

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_RHS_triple
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_assoc_RHS_triple :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    mv_gp sq F (mv_gp sq G H) U
    ==
    sumQ (List.map (fun A =>
    sumQ (List.map (fun B =>
    sumQ (List.map (fun C =>
      if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor A (mask_xor B C)) U
      then (F A * G B * H C
            * basis_mul_coeff sq B C
            * basis_mul_coeff sq A (mask_xor B C))%Q
      else 0%Q) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: mv_gp_assoc_LHS_triple
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_assoc_LHS_triple :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    mv_gp sq (mv_gp sq F G) H U
    ==
    sumQ (List.map (fun A =>
    sumQ (List.map (fun B =>
    sumQ (List.map (fun C =>
      if mask_eq_dec (mask_xor (mask_xor A B) C) U
      then (F A * G B * H C
            * basis_mul_coeff sq A B
            * basis_mul_coeff sq (mask_xor A B) C)%Q
      else 0%Q) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n))) (all_masks n)).

items.name: mv_gp_assoc
items.statement:
Lemma mv_gp_assoc :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G H : MV n) (U : Mask n),
    mv_gp sq (mv_gp sq F G) H U
    ==
    mv_gp sq F (mv_gp sq G H) U.

items.name: eval_conv
items.statement:
Lemma eval_conv :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (s : Corner n),
    eval (mv_conv F G) s == (eval F s * eval G s)%Q.

items.name: grade
items.statement:
Definition grade {n} (m : Mask n) : nat :=
  List.count_occ Bool.bool_dec (Vector.to_list m) true.

items.name: grade_cons_true
items.statement:
Lemma grade_cons_true : forall n (m : Mask n),
  grade (Vector.cons _ true _ m) = S (grade m).

items.name: grade_cons_false
items.statement:
Lemma grade_cons_false : forall n (m : Mask n),
  grade (Vector.cons _ false _ m) = grade m.

items.name: grade_empty_mask
items.statement:
Lemma grade_empty_mask : forall n,
  grade (mask_empty (n:=n)) = 0%nat.

items.name: grade_full_mask
items.statement:
Lemma grade_full_mask : forall n,
  grade (Vector.const true n) = n.

items.name: grade_single
items.statement:
Lemma grade_single : forall n (i : Fin.t n),
  grade (mask_single i) = 1%nat.

items.name: grade_le_n
items.statement: Lemma grade_le_n : forall n (m : Mask n), (grade m <= n)%nat.

items.name: grade_xor_le
items.statement:
Lemma grade_xor_le : forall n (A B : Mask n),
  (grade (mask_xor A B) <= grade A + grade B)%nat.

items.name: grade_basis_mul_mask_le
items.statement:
Lemma grade_basis_mul_mask_le : forall n (A B : Mask n),
  (grade (basis_mul_mask A B) <= grade A + grade B)%nat.

items.name: Qeq_bool_false_neq
items.statement:
Lemma Qeq_bool_false_neq : forall x y : Q,
  Qeq_bool x y = false -> ~(x == y).

items.name: Qeq_dec
items.statement: Definition Qeq_dec (x y : Q) : {x == y} + {~(x == y)}.

items.name: max_grade
items.statement:
Definition max_grade {n} (F : MV n) : nat :=
  List.fold_right Nat.max 0%nat
    (List.map (fun m => if Qeq_bool (F m) 0 then 0%nat else grade m)
              (all_masks n)).

items.name: fold_max_ge_In
items.statement:
Lemma fold_max_ge_In :
  forall (l : list nat) (x : nat),
    List.In x l -> (x <= List.fold_right Nat.max 0%nat l)%nat.

items.name: fold_max_le_bound
items.statement:
Lemma fold_max_le_bound :
  forall (l : list nat) (k : nat),
    (forall x, List.In x l -> (x <= k)%nat) ->
    (List.fold_right Nat.max 0%nat l <= k)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_spec
items.statement:
Lemma max_grade_spec :
  forall n (F : MV n) (m : Mask n),
    ~(F m == 0) -> (grade m <= max_grade F)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_le_n
items.statement:
Lemma max_grade_le_n :
  forall n (F : MV n), (max_grade F <= n)%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded
items.statement:
Definition grade_bounded {n} (F : MV n) (k : nat) : Prop :=
  forall m : Mask n, (grade m > k)%nat -> F m == 0.

items.name: max_grade_bounded
items.statement:
Lemma max_grade_bounded :
  forall n (F : MV n), grade_bounded F (max_grade F).

items.name: bounded_implies_max_grade_le
items.statement:
Lemma bounded_implies_max_grade_le :
  forall n (F : MV n) (k : nat),
    grade_bounded F k -> (max_grade F <= k)%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_mono
items.statement:
Lemma grade_bounded_mono :
  forall n (F : MV n) (j k : nat),
    grade_bounded F j -> (j <= k)%nat -> grade_bounded F k.

items.name: grade_bounded_zero
items.statement:
Lemma grade_bounded_zero :
  forall n (k : nat), grade_bounded (@mv_zero n) k.

items.name: grade_bounded_add
items.statement:
Lemma grade_bounded_add :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (j k : nat),
    grade_bounded F j ->
    grade_bounded G k ->
    grade_bounded (mv_add F G) (Nat.max j k).

items.name: max_grade_add_le
items.statement:
Lemma max_grade_add_le :
  forall n (F G : MV n),
    (max_grade (mv_add F G) <= Nat.max (max_grade F) (max_grade G))%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_gp
items.statement:
Lemma grade_bounded_gp :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n) (j k : nat),
    grade_bounded F j ->
    grade_bounded G k ->
    grade_bounded (mv_gp sq F G) (j + k)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_gp_le
items.statement:
Lemma max_grade_gp_le :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (F G : MV n),
    (max_grade (mv_gp sq F G) <= max_grade F + max_grade G)%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_conv
items.statement:
Lemma grade_bounded_conv :
  forall n (F G : MV n) (j k : nat),
    grade_bounded F j ->
    grade_bounded G k ->
    grade_bounded (mv_conv F G) (j + k)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_conv_le
items.statement:
Lemma max_grade_conv_le :
  forall n (F G : MV n),
    (max_grade (mv_conv F G) <= max_grade F + max_grade G)%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_basis_single
items.statement:
Lemma grade_bounded_basis_single :
  forall n (i : Fin.t n), grade_bounded (basis (mask_single i)) 1%nat.

items.name: grade_bounded_scale_one
items.statement:
Lemma grade_bounded_scale_one :
  forall n (c : Q), grade_bounded (mv_scale c (@mv_one n)) 0%nat.

items.name: GA_expr
items.statement:
Inductive GA_expr (n : nat) : Type :=
  | Basis  : Fin.t n -> GA_expr n
  | Scalar : Q -> GA_expr n
  | Add    : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n
  | Mul    : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n                      
  | Conv   : GA_expr n -> GA_expr n -> GA_expr n.

items.name: eval_expr
items.statement:
Fixpoint eval_expr {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) : MV n :=
  match e with
  | Basis i   => basis (mask_single i)
  | Scalar c  => mv_scale c mv_one
  | Add e1 e2 => mv_add (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)
  | Mul e1 e2 => mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)
  | Conv e1 e2 => mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)
  end.

items.name: grade_bound
items.statement:
Fixpoint grade_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Basis _   => 1%nat
  | Scalar _  => 0%nat
  | Add e1 e2 => Nat.max (grade_bound e1) (grade_bound e2)
  | Mul e1 e2 => (grade_bound e1 + grade_bound e2)%nat
  | Conv e1 e2 => (grade_bound e1 + grade_bound e2)%nat
  end.

items.name: eval_grade_bounded
items.statement:
Theorem eval_grade_bounded :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
    grade_bounded (eval_expr sq e) (grade_bound e).

items.name: max_grade_eval_le
items.statement:
Corollary max_grade_eval_le :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
    (max_grade (eval_expr sq e) <= grade_bound e)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_during
items.statement:
Fixpoint max_grade_during {n} (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Basis _   => 1%nat
  | Scalar _  => 0%nat
  | Add e1 e2 =>
      Nat.max (max_grade_during sq e1)
              (max_grade_during sq e2)
  | Mul e1 e2 =>
      Nat.max
        (Nat.max (max_grade_during sq e1)
                 (max_grade_during sq e2))
        (max_grade (mv_gp sq (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)))
  | Conv e1 e2 =>
      Nat.max
        (Nat.max (max_grade_during sq e1)
                 (max_grade_during sq e2))
        (max_grade (mv_conv (eval_expr sq e1) (eval_expr sq e2)))
  end.

items.name: max_grade_le_during
items.statement:
Lemma max_grade_le_during :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
    (max_grade (eval_expr sq e) <= max_grade_during sq e)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_during_le_grade_bound
items.statement:
Lemma max_grade_during_le_grade_bound :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
    (max_grade_during sq e <= grade_bound e)%nat.

items.name: max_grade_during_eval_le_grade_bound
items.statement:
Corollary max_grade_during_eval_le_grade_bound :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
    (max_grade (eval_expr sq e) <= grade_bound e)%nat /\
    (max_grade_during sq e <= grade_bound e)%nat.

items.name: excursion_lower_bound
items.statement:
Theorem excursion_lower_bound :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n) (F : MV n),
    eval_expr sq e = F ->
    (exists m : Mask n, (grade m >= n)%nat /\ ~(F m == 0)) ->
    (max_grade_during sq e >= n)%nat.

items.name: sign_to_bool
items.statement:
Definition sign_to_bool (s : Sign) : bool :=
  match s with Pos => true | Neg => false end.

items.name: XOR_n_func
items.statement:
Definition XOR_n_func {n} (c : Corner n) : bool :=
  List.fold_right xorb false
    (Vector.to_list (Vector.map sign_to_bool c)).

items.name: XOR_n_func_cons
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_n_func_cons :
  forall n (h : Sign) (c : Corner n),
    @XOR_n_func (S n) (Vector.cons _ h _ c)
    = xorb (sign_to_bool h) (@XOR_n_func n c).

items.name: bQ_negb
items.statement: Lemma bQ_negb : forall b : bool, bQ (negb b) == (1 - bQ b)%Q.

items.name: xor_sum
items.statement:
Definition xor_sum (n : nat) : Q :=
  sumQ (List.map
    (fun a : Corner n =>
       (bQ (@XOR_n_func n a) * chi' (Vector.const true n) a)%Q)
    (all_corners n)).

items.name: embed_XOR_full_mask
items.statement:
Lemma embed_XOR_full_mask :
  forall n,
    embed (@XOR_n_func n) (Vector.const true n)
    == ((1 / pow2 n) * xor_sum n)%Q.

items.name: chi_full_sum_zero
items.statement:
Lemma chi_full_sum_zero :
  forall n,
    sumQ (List.map
      (fun a : Corner (S n) =>
         chi' (Vector.const true (S n)) a)
      (all_corners (S n)))
    == 0.

items.name: xor_sum_base
items.statement: Lemma xor_sum_base : xor_sum 1 == 1.

items.name: sumQ_map_sub
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_sub :
  forall (A : Type) (f g : A -> Q) (l : list A),
    sumQ (List.map (fun x => (f x - g x)%Q) l) ==
    (sumQ (List.map f l) - sumQ (List.map g l))%Q.

items.name: xor_sum_step
items.statement:
Lemma xor_sum_step :
  forall n, (n > 0)%nat ->
    xor_sum (S n) == ((-2) * xor_sum n)%Q.

items.name: Qmul_nonzero_l
items.statement:
Lemma Qmul_nonzero_l :
  forall p q : Q, ~(p == 0) -> ~(q == 0) -> ~(p * q == 0).

items.name: Qneg2_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma Qneg2_nonzero : ~((-2)%Q == 0).

items.name: Qinv_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma Qinv_nonzero : forall q : Q, ~(q == 0) -> ~(/q == 0).

items.name: Qdiv1_nonzero
items.statement: Lemma Qdiv1_nonzero : forall q : Q, ~(q == 0) -> ~((1 / q) == 0).

items.name: xor_sum_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma xor_sum_nonzero :
  forall n, (n > 0)%nat -> ~(xor_sum n == 0).

items.name: XOR_has_grade_n_component
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_has_grade_n_component :
  forall n,
    (n > 0)%nat ->
    ~(embed (@XOR_n_func n) (Vector.const true n) == 0).

items.name: parity_excursion
items.statement:
Theorem parity_excursion :
  forall n sq (e : GA_expr n),
    (n > 0)%nat ->
    eval_expr sq e = embed (@XOR_n_func n) ->
    (max_grade_during sq e >= n)%nat.

items.name: length_filter_le
items.statement:
Lemma length_filter_le :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A),
    (length (filter p l) <= length l)%nat.

items.name: NoDup_filter
items.statement:
Lemma NoDup_filter :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A),
    NoDup l -> NoDup (filter p l).

items.name: NoDup_incl_length
items.statement:
Lemma NoDup_incl_length :
  forall (A : Type) (l1 l2 : list A),
    NoDup l1 -> incl l1 l2 -> (length l1 <= length l2)%nat.

items.name: filter_ext_in
items.statement:
Lemma filter_ext_in :
  forall (A : Type) (l : list A) (p q : A -> bool),
    (forall x, In x l -> p x = q x) ->
    filter p l = filter q l.

items.name: all_masks_length_pow2
items.statement:
Lemma all_masks_length_pow2 :
  forall n, length (all_masks n) = Nat.pow 2 n.

items.statement: Lemma Qeq_bool_10 : Qeq_bool 1 0 = false.

items.statement: Lemma Qeq_bool_00 : Qeq_bool 0 0 = true.

items.name: support_size
items.statement:
Definition support_size {n} (F : MV n) : nat :=
  length (List.filter (fun m => negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0))
                 (all_masks n)).

items.name: support_size_ext
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_ext :
  forall n (F G : MV n),
    (forall m, F m == G m) ->
    support_size F = support_size G.

items.name: support_list
items.statement:
Definition support_list {n} (F : MV n) : list (Mask n) :=
  filter (fun m => negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0)) (all_masks n).

items.name: support_size_le_2n
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_le_2n : forall n (F : MV n),
  (support_size F <= Nat.pow 2 n)%nat.

items.name: support_size_zero
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_zero : forall n,
  support_size (@mv_zero n) = 0%nat.

items.name: filter_all_false_nil
items.statement:
Lemma filter_all_false_nil :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A),
    (forall x, In x l -> p x = false) ->
    filter p l = [].

items.name: filter_singleton
items.statement:
Lemma filter_singleton :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A) (a : A),
    NoDup l ->
    In a l ->
    p a = true ->
    (forall x, In x l -> x <> a -> p x = false) ->
    filter p l = [a].

items.name: support_size_basis
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_basis : forall n (i : Fin.t n),
  support_size (basis (mask_single i)) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_mv_one
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_mv_one : forall n,
  support_size (@mv_one n) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_scale
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_scale : forall n (c : Q) (F : MV n),
  ~(c == 0) ->
  support_size (mv_scale c F) = support_size F.

items.name: support_size_add
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_add : forall n (F G : MV n),
  (support_size (mv_add F G) <= support_size F + support_size G)%nat.

items.name: support_size_conv
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_conv : forall n (F G : MV n),
  (support_size (mv_conv F G) <= support_size F * support_size G)%nat.

items.name: support_size_bound
items.statement:
Fixpoint support_size_bound {n} (e : GA_expr n) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Basis _    => 1
  | Scalar _   => 1
  | Cln_Grade.Add e1 e2  => support_size_bound e1 + support_size_bound e2
  | Mul e1 e2  =>
      match e1, e2 with
      | Scalar _, _ => support_size_bound e2
      | _, Scalar _ => support_size_bound e1
      | _, _        => Nat.pow 2 n
      end
  | Conv e1 e2 => support_size_bound e1 * support_size_bound e2
  end.

items.name: eval_mul_scalar_l
items.statement:
Lemma eval_mul_scalar_l :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n),
    forall m,
      eval_expr sq (Mul (Scalar q) e) m
      ==
      mv_scale q (eval_expr sq e) m.

items.name: eval_mul_scalar_r
items.statement:
Lemma eval_mul_scalar_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n),
    forall m,
      eval_expr sq (Mul e (Scalar q)) m
      ==
      mv_scale q (eval_expr sq e) m.

items.name: support_size_scalar_mul_l
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_scalar_mul_l :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n),
    (support_size (eval_expr sq (Mul (Scalar q) e))
     <= support_size (eval_expr sq e))%nat.

items.name: support_size_scalar_mul_r
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_scalar_mul_r :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (q : Q) (e : GA_expr n),
    (support_size (eval_expr sq (Mul e (Scalar q)))
     <= support_size (eval_expr sq e))%nat.

items.name: eval_support_size_le
items.statement:
Theorem eval_support_size_le :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (e : GA_expr n),
    (support_size (eval_expr sq e) <= support_size_bound e)%nat.

items.name: formula_size
items.statement:
Fixpoint formula_size {n} (phi : BoolFormula n) : nat :=
  match phi with
  | BVar _   => 1
  | BConst _ => 1
  | BAnd p q => 1 + formula_size p + formula_size q
  | BOr p q  => 1 + formula_size p + formula_size q
  | BNot p   => 1 + formula_size p
  end.

items.name: formula_size_pos
items.statement:
Lemma formula_size_pos : forall n (phi : BoolFormula n),
  (formula_size phi >= 1)%nat.

items.name: pow2_pos
items.statement: Lemma pow2_pos : forall k, (1 <= Nat.pow 2 k)%nat.

items.name: pow2_ge_2
items.statement: Lemma pow2_ge_2 : forall k, (k >= 1)%nat -> (2 <= Nat.pow 2 k)%nat.

items.name: support_size_bound_translate
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_bound_translate :
  forall n (phi : BoolFormula n),
    (support_size_bound (translate phi) <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: translate_support_size_bound
items.statement:
Corollary translate_support_size_bound :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n),
    (support_size (eval_expr sq (translate phi))
     <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: neg1_pow
items.statement:
Definition neg1_pow (k : nat) : Q :=
  if Nat.even k then 1%Q else (-(1))%Q.

items.name: neg1_pow_S
items.statement: Lemma neg1_pow_S : forall k, neg1_pow (S k) == (- neg1_pow k)%Q.

items.name: neg1_pow_neq_0
items.statement: Lemma neg1_pow_neq_0 : forall k, ~(neg1_pow k == 0).

items.name: bQ_XOR_plus_chi
items.statement:
Lemma bQ_XOR_plus_chi : forall n (s : Corner n),
  (2 * bQ (XOR_n_func s) + neg1_pow n * chi' (Vector.const true n) s == 1)%Q.

items.name: XOR_explicit
items.statement:
Definition XOR_explicit {n} : MV n :=
  mv_add (mv_scale (1#2) (basis mask_empty))
         (mv_scale (- neg1_pow n * (1#2)) (basis (Vector.const true n))).

items.name: eval_XOR_explicit
items.statement:
Lemma eval_XOR_explicit : forall n (s : Corner n),
  eval (@XOR_explicit n) s == bQ (XOR_n_func s).

items.name: embed_XOR_eq_explicit
items.statement:
Lemma embed_XOR_eq_explicit : forall n (m : Mask n),
  embed (@XOR_n_func n) m == (@XOR_explicit n) m.

items.name: mask_empty_neq_full
items.statement:
Lemma mask_empty_neq_full : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> @mask_empty n <> Vector.const true n.

items.name: XOR_explicit_empty_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_explicit_empty_nonzero : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> ~(@XOR_explicit n mask_empty == 0).

items.name: XOR_explicit_full_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_explicit_full_nonzero : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat -> ~(@XOR_explicit n (Vector.const true n) == 0).

items.name: XOR_explicit_other_zero
items.statement:
Lemma XOR_explicit_other_zero : forall n (m : Mask n),
  m <> mask_empty ->
  m <> Vector.const true n ->
  @XOR_explicit n m == 0.

items.name: support_size_at_least_two
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_at_least_two :
  forall n (F : MV n) (a b : Mask n),
    a <> b -> ~(F a == 0) -> ~(F b == 0) ->
    (2 <= support_size F)%nat.

items.name: support_size_basis_general
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_basis_general : forall n (M : Mask n),
  support_size (basis M) = 1%nat.

items.name: support_size_XOR_explicit_le
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_XOR_explicit_le :
  forall n, (support_size (@XOR_explicit n) <= 2)%nat.

items.name: support_size_XOR
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_XOR : forall n,
  (n > 0)%nat ->
  support_size (embed (@XOR_n_func n)) = 2%nat.

items.name: IP_raw
items.statement:
Fixpoint IP_raw (l : list Sign) : bool :=
  match l with
  | nil         => false
  | _ :: nil    => false                                    
  | x :: y :: rest =>
      xorb (andb (sign_to_bool x) (sign_to_bool y))
           (IP_raw rest)
  end.

items.name: IP_n_func
items.statement:
Definition IP_n_func {n} (c : Corner n) : bool :=
  IP_raw (Vector.to_list c).

items.name: IP_n_func_cons2
items.statement:
Lemma IP_n_func_cons2 :
  forall n (x y : Sign) (c : Corner n),
    @IP_n_func (S (S n)) (Vector.cons _ x _ (Vector.cons _ y _ c))
    = xorb (andb (sign_to_bool x) (sign_to_bool y))
           (@IP_n_func n c).

items.name: signed
items.statement: Definition signed (b : bool) : Q := if b then (-1)%Q else 1%Q.

items.name: signed_xorb
items.statement: Lemma signed_xorb : forall a b, signed (xorb a b) == (signed a * signed b)%Q.

items.name: signed_walsh
items.statement:
Definition signed_walsh {n} (f : Corner n -> bool) (M : Mask n) : Q :=
  sumQ (List.map (fun a => (signed (f a) * chi' M a)%Q) (all_corners n)).

items.name: bQ_via_signed
items.statement: Lemma bQ_via_signed : forall b, bQ b == ((1 - signed b) * (1#2))%Q.

items.name: AND_2
items.statement:
Definition AND_2 (c : Corner 2) : bool :=
  andb (sign_to_bool (Vector.hd c))
       (sign_to_bool (Vector.hd (Vector.tl c))).

items.name: signed_walsh_2
items.statement:
Definition signed_walsh_2 (f : Corner 2 -> bool) (b1 b2 : bool) : Q :=
  signed_walsh f (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ (Vector.nil _))).

items.name: prod_pairs_raw
items.statement:
Fixpoint prod_pairs_raw (l : list bool) : Q :=
  match l with
  | []            => 1%Q
  | [_]           => 1%Q                                    
  | b1 :: b2 :: rest =>
      (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs_raw rest)%Q
  end.

items.name: prod_pairs
items.statement:
Definition prod_pairs (m : nat) (M : Mask (m + m)) : Q :=
  prod_pairs_raw (Vector.to_list M).

items.name: Sn_plus_Sn
items.statement: Lemma Sn_plus_Sn : forall m, S (S ((m + m)%nat)) = (S m + S m)%nat.

items.name: mask_cast
items.statement:
Definition mask_cast {n1 n2} (H : n1 = n2) (M : Mask n1) : Mask n2 :=
  eq_rect n1 (Vector.t bool) M n2 H.

items.name: to_list_cast
items.statement:
Lemma to_list_cast : forall n1 n2 (H : n1 = n2) (M : Mask n1),
  Vector.to_list (mask_cast H M) = Vector.to_list M.

items.name: prod_pairs_cons2
items.statement:
Lemma prod_pairs_cons2 : forall m (b1 b2 : bool) (M : Mask (m + m)),
  prod_pairs (S m) (mask_cast (Sn_plus_Sn m)
    (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ M)))
  = (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs m M)%Q.

items.name: vector_peel2
items.statement:
Lemma vector_peel2 : forall (A : Type) (n : nat) (v : Vector.t A (S (S n))),
  exists (a1 a2 : A) (v' : Vector.t A n),
    Vector.to_list v = a1 :: a2 :: Vector.to_list v'.

items.name: Sm_plus_Sm
items.statement: Lemma Sm_plus_Sm : forall m, (S m + S m)%nat = (S (S (m + m)%nat)).

items.name: mask_decompose2
items.statement:
Lemma mask_decompose2 : forall m (M : Mask (S m + S m)),
  exists b1 b2 (M'' : Mask (m + m)),
    Vector.to_list M = b1 :: b2 :: Vector.to_list M''.

items.name: prod_pairs_unfold
items.statement:
Lemma prod_pairs_unfold : forall m (M : Mask (S m + S m)),
  forall b1 b2 (M'' : Mask (m + m)),
    Vector.to_list M = b1 :: b2 :: Vector.to_list M'' ->
    prod_pairs (S m) M = (signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 * prod_pairs m M'')%Q.

items.name: inject_Z
items.statement: Definition inject_Z (z : Z) : Q := z # 1.

items.name: embed_via_signed_walsh
items.statement:
Lemma embed_via_signed_walsh : forall n (f : Corner n -> bool) (M : Mask n),
  embed f M == ((1 / pow2 n) * ((1#2) * (if mask_eq_dec M mask_empty then pow2 n else 0)
                - (1#2) * signed_walsh f M))%Q.

signed_walsh_AND_2var

Lemma signed_walsh_AND_2var : forall (b1 b2 : bool),
  signed_walsh_2 AND_2 b1 b2 ==

items.name: all_corners_S
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_S : forall n,
  all_corners (S n)
  =
    map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos n c) (all_corners n)
 ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg n c) (all_corners n).

items.name: all_corners_SS
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_SS : forall n,
  all_corners (S (S n))
  =
     map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Pos n c)) (all_corners n)
  ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Pos (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Neg n c)) (all_corners n)
  ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Pos n c)) (all_corners n)
  ++ map (fun c => Vector.cons Sign Neg (S n)
                   (Vector.cons Sign Neg n c)) (all_corners n).

items.name: chi'_cons2_factor
items.statement:
Lemma chi'_cons2_factor :
  forall n (b1 b2 : bool) (m : Mask n) (x y : Sign) (c : Corner n),
    chi' (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ m))
         (Vector.cons _ x  _ (Vector.cons _ y  _ c))
    ==
    ((if b1 then sQ x else 1%Q) *
     (if b2 then sQ y else 1%Q) *
     chi' m c)%Q.

items.statement:
Lemma to_list_inj : forall (A : Type) (n : nat) (v1 v2 : Vector.t A n),

items.name: sumQ_map_mul_l
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_mul_l :
  forall (A:Type) (k:Q) (l:list A) (f:A->Q),
    sumQ (map (fun x => k * f x) l) == k * sumQ (map f l).

items.name: Qmult_plus_distr_r_Qeq
items.statement:
Lemma Qmult_plus_distr_r_Qeq : forall k x y : Q,
  (x + y) * k == x * k + y * k.

items.name: sumQ_map_mul_r
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_map_mul_r :
  forall (A:Type) (k:Q) (l:list A) (f:A->Q),
    sumQ (map (fun x => (f x * k)%Q) l) == (sumQ (map f l) * k)%Q.

items.name: chi_eq_chi'
items.statement:
Lemma chi_eq_chi' : forall n (m:Mask n) (c:Corner n),
  chi m c == chi' m c.

items.name: sumQ_flat_map
items.statement:
Lemma sumQ_flat_map :
  forall (A B : Type) (l : list A) (g : A -> list B) (f : B -> Q),
    sumQ (map f (flat_map g l))
    ==
    sumQ (map (fun a => sumQ (map f (g a))) l).

items.name: map_flat_map
items.statement:
Lemma map_flat_map :
  forall (A B C : Type) (l : list A) (g : A -> list B) (f : B -> C),
    map f (flat_map g l) = flat_map (fun a => map f (g a)) l.

items.name: cons2
items.statement:
Definition cons2 {n} (c2 : Corner 2) (x : Corner n) : Corner (S (S n)) :=
  Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd c2) (S n)
    (Vector.cons Sign (Vector.hd (Vector.tl c2)) n x).

items.name: all_corners_SS_flatmap
items.statement:
Lemma all_corners_SS_flatmap :
  forall n,
    all_corners (S (S n)) =
      flat_map
        (fun c2 : Corner 2 =>
           map (fun x : Corner n => cons2 c2 x) (all_corners n))
        (all_corners 2).

items.name: signed_walsh_tensor2
items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_tensor2 :
  forall n (g : Corner 2 -> bool) (h : Corner n -> bool)
         (b1 b2 : bool) (m : Mask n),
    signed_walsh
      (fun a : Corner (S (S n)) =>
         xorb (g (Vector.cons _ (Vector.hd a) _
                  (Vector.cons _ (Vector.hd (Vector.tl a)) _ (Vector.nil _))))
              (h (Vector.tl (Vector.tl a))))
      (Vector.cons _ b1 _ (Vector.cons _ b2 _ m))
    ==
    (signed_walsh_2 g b1 b2 * signed_walsh h m)%Q.

items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_IP_factored : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)),
  signed_walsh (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M == prod_pairs m M.

items.statement:
Lemma signed_walsh_IP_magnitude : forall m (M : Mask (m + m)),
  (m > 0)%nat ->
  exists s : bool, signed_walsh (@IP_n_func (m + m)) M 
                    == signed s * inject_Z (Z.pow 2 (Z.of_nat m)).

items.name: pow2_injectZ

Lemma pow2_injectZ : forall n,
  pow2 n == inject_Z (2 ^ Z.of_nat n).

items.name: support_size_IP
items.statement:
Lemma support_size_IP : forall m,
  (m > 0)%nat ->
  support_size (embed (@IP_n_func (m + m))) = Nat.pow 2 (m + m).

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound
items.statement:
Theorem IP_formula_size_lower_bound :
  forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m + m)) (phi : BoolFormula (m + m)),
    (m > 0)%nat ->
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = @IP_n_func (m + m) ->
    (formula_size phi >= m)%nat.

items.name: IP_formula_size_lower_bound_tight
items.statement:
Corollary IP_formula_size_lower_bound_tight :
  forall m (sq : Vector.t Q (m + m)) (phi : BoolFormula (m + m)),
    (m > 0)%nat ->
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = @IP_n_func (m + m) ->
    (formula_size phi >= m + m)%nat.

items.name: formula_size_lower_bound_from_support
items.statement:
Lemma formula_size_lower_bound_from_support :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    (support_size (embed f) <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_k

  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool) k,
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    (k <= support_size (embed f))%nat ->
    (k <= Nat.pow 2 (formula_size phi))%nat.

items.name: formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_pow2
items.statement:
Corollary formula_size_lower_bound_from_support_pow2 :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool) t,
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    (Nat.pow 2 t <= support_size (embed f))%nat ->
    (t <= formula_size phi)%nat.

items.name: formula_size_full_support
items.statement:
Corollary formula_size_full_support :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    support_size (embed f) = Nat.pow 2 n ->

items.statement:

items.name: full_support_implies_size_ge_n
items.statement:
Corollary full_support_implies_size_ge_n :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->

items.name: occurs_var
items.statement:
Fixpoint occurs_var {n} (i : Fin.t n) (phi : BoolFormula n) : Prop :=
  match phi with
  | BVar j     => i = j
  | BConst _   => False
  | BAnd p q   => occurs_var i p \/ occurs_var i q
  | BOr  p q   => occurs_var i p \/ occurs_var i q
  | BNot p     => occurs_var i p
  end.

items.name: length_filter_eq_Forall
items.statement:
Lemma length_filter_eq_Forall :
  forall (A : Type) (p : A -> bool) (l : list A),
    length (List.filter p l) = length l ->
    List.Forall (fun x => p x = true) l.

items.name: full_support_all_masks_nz
items.statement:
Lemma full_support_all_masks_nz :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n ->
    forall m, List.In m (all_masks n) ->
      negb (Qeq_bool (F m) 0) = true.

items.name: nz_bool_to_neq0
items.statement:
Lemma nz_bool_to_neq0 :
  forall q : Q,
    negb (Qeq_bool q 0) = true ->
    ~ q == 0.

items.name: full_support_all_nonzero
items.statement:
Lemma full_support_all_nonzero :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n ->
    forall m, In m (all_masks n) -> ~(F m == 0).

items.name: eval_bf_independent_if_not_occurs
items.statement:
Lemma eval_bf_independent_if_not_occurs :
  forall n (phi : BoolFormula n) i,
    ~ occurs_var (n:=n) i phi ->
    forall c1 c2 : Corner n,
      (forall j, j <> i -> Vector.nth c1 j = Vector.nth c2 j) ->
      eval_bf phi c1 = eval_bf phi c2.

items.name: inner_sum_independent_zero
items.statement:
Lemma inner_sum_independent_zero :
  forall n (i : Fin.t n) (f : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall c1 c2 : Corner n,
      (forall j : Fin.t n, j <> i -> Vector.nth c1 j = Vector.nth c2 j) ->
      f c1 = f c2) ->
    sumQ (List.map (fun a => (bQ (f a) * sQ (Vector.nth a i))%Q)
                   (all_corners n)) == 0.

items.name: embed_mask_single_zero_if_independent
items.statement:
Lemma embed_mask_single_zero_if_independent :
  forall n (f : Corner n -> bool) (i : Fin.t n),
    (forall c1 c2 : Corner n,
      (forall j, j <> i -> Vector.nth c1 j = Vector.nth c2 j) ->
      f c1 = f c2) ->
    embed f (mask_single i) == 0.

items.name: full_support_implies_reads_all
items.statement:
Corollary full_support_implies_reads_all :
  forall n (sq : Vector.t Q n) (phi : BoolFormula n) (f : Corner n -> bool),
    (forall i, Vector.nth sq i == 1) ->
    eval_bf phi = f ->
    support_size (embed f) = Nat.pow 2 n ->
    forall i, occurs_var i phi.

items.statement:
Theorem max_grade_of_full_support :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n ->
    max_grade F = n.

items.name: full_support_implies_max_grade_n
items.statement:
Theorem full_support_implies_max_grade_n :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    support_size F = Nat.pow 2 n ->

items.name: support_or_max_grade
items.statement:
Corollary support_or_max_grade :
  forall n (F : MV n),
    support_size F <> Nat.pow 2 n \/ max_grade F = n.
